title: Stage-adaptive audio diffusion modeling
summary: Recent progress in diffusion-based audio generation and restoration has substantially improved performance across heterogeneous conditioning regimes, including text-conditioned audio generation and audio-conditioned super-resolution. However, training audio diffusion models remains computationally expensive, and most existing pipelines still rely on static optimization recipes that treat the relative importance of training signals as fixed throughout learning. In this work, we argue that a major source of inefficiency lies in the evolving balance between semantic acquisition and generation-oriented refinement. Early training places stronger emphasis on acquiring condition-aligned semantic structure and coarse global organization, whereas later training increasingly emphasizes temporal consistency, perceptual fidelity, and fine-detail refinement. To characterize this evolving balance, we introduce a progress-based regime variable derived from the training-time slope of an SSL-space discrepancy, which measures semantic progress during training. Based on this signal, we develop three complementary stage-aware mechanisms: decayed SSL guidance for early semantic bootstrapping, self-adaptive timestep sampling driven by the regime variable, and structure-aware regularization activated from convergent grouped organization in parameter space. We evaluate these mechanisms on text-conditioned audio generation and audio-conditioned super-resolution. Across both settings, the proposed stage-aware strategies improve convergence behavior and yield gains on the primary generation and spectral reconstruction metrics over standard static baselines. These results support the view that efficient audio diffusion training can benefit from treating external guidance, internal organization, and optimization emphasis as stage-dependent components rather than fixed ingredients.

AI.title_translation: 阶段自适应音频扩散建模
AI.tldr: 通过根据训练进度动态调整引导、采样和正则化策略，显著提升了音频扩散模型的训练效率与生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的音频扩散模型训练通常采用静态优化策略，忽略了模型在训练过程中对语义结构获取与细节精细化需求的变化，导致计算资源浪费和训练效率低下。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于自监督学习（SSL）空间差异的训练进度变量，并据此设计了三种机制：用于早期语义引导的衰减式SSL引导、基于进度变量的自适应时间步采样，以及基于参数空间收敛组织的结构感知正则化。
AI.result: 在文本条件音频生成和音频超分辨率任务中，该方法相比标准静态基线模型，表现出更好的收敛特性，并在生成质量和频谱重建指标上取得了显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入阶段感知机制，将训练过程中的外部引导、内部组织和优化重点视为动态变量，能有效提升音频扩散模型的收敛性能与生成质量。
AI.translation: 最近在基于扩散的音频生成和恢复方面取得的进展，显著提高了在各种异构条件设置下的性能，包括文本条件音频生成和音频条件超分辨率。然而，训练音频扩散模型仍然计算昂贵，且大多数现有流水线仍依赖于将训练信号的相对重要性视为固定不变的静态优化方案。在这项工作中，我们认为效率低下的一个主要根源在于语义获取与面向生成的细化之间的平衡不断演变。训练初期更强调获取与条件一致的语义结构和粗略的全局组织，而后期训练则越来越强调时间一致性、感知保真度和精细细节的优化。为了表征这种演变的平衡，我们引入了一个基于训练时间SSL空间差异斜率的进度 regime 变量，该变量用于衡量训练期间的语义进度。基于此信号，我们开发了三种互补的阶段感知机制：用于早期语义引导的衰减SSL引导、由 regime 变量驱动的自适应时间步采样，以及从参数空间中收敛的分组组织激活的结构感知正则化。我们在文本条件音频生成和音频条件超分辨率上评估了这些机制。在这两种设置中，所提出的阶段感知策略都改善了收敛行为，并在主要生成和频谱重建指标上优于标准的静态基线。这些结果支持了一个观点：即高效的音频扩散训练可以通过将外部引导、内部组织和优化重点视为阶段依赖的组件，而不是固定要素来获益。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种阶段自适应的音频扩散模型训练方法。通过监测训练过程中语义获取的进度，动态调整训练策略，包括SSL引导、时间步采样和正则化，从而在训练的不同阶段平衡语义结构学习与细节精细化，有效提升了模型性能与训练效率。
AI.keywords: 音频扩散模型, 阶段自适应, 自监督学习, 生成模型, 训练效率
AI.comments: 该论文通过量化训练过程中的语义获取与细节生成之间的动态平衡，提出了一种阶段自适应的训练策略。这种方法打破了传统扩散模型训练中静态优化的限制，在提升音频生成质量的同时改善了收敛效率，为高效训练大规模生成模型提供了新的思路。

title: Event-Based Early Warning of Vineyard Disease Risk from Environmental Time Series
summary: Accurate early warning of vineyard disease risk from environmental observations is essential for timely intervention and more sustainable crop protection. However, many existing studies formulate disease prediction as daily presence classification, which can favor persistence-driven predictions and provide only limited support for actionable short-horizon warning. In this paper, we present an event-based approach for early warning of vineyard disease risk from environmental time series and evaluate it through a vineyard case study. Rather than predicting daily disease status, the task is reformulated to predict transitions into annotated disease-risk periods within a future window of 3-7 days. To reduce fragmentation caused by short interruptions in the binary labels, new events are defined only after a minimum disease-free gap. This formulation encourages models to capture environmental precursors associated with upcoming risk periods instead of merely reproducing temporal persistence. Using multi-year agro-meteorological data, we construct input representations that capture humidity dynamics, rainfall accumulation, temperature variability, and seasonal structure through cyclic temporal encoding. We evaluate representative methods from classical machine learning and deep learning, including XGBoost, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, and Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCNs), using both standard classification metrics and an event-oriented early warning protocol. The results show that the event-based formulation supports practical short-horizon warning, while the compared models exhibit distinct trade-offs between event recall, lead time, and false-alert behavior. Overall, the study underscores the importance of problem formulation in environmental time-series learning and demonstrates the value of event-based prediction for vineyard disease warning systems.

AI.title_translation: 基于环境时间序列的葡萄园病害风险事件预警
AI.tldr: 通过将葡萄园病害预测从“每日分类”转变为“风险事件预警”，该研究有效提高了病害预测的实用性和准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的病害预测多采用每日状态分类，容易导致对时间持久性的过度依赖，且难以提供具有实际操作意义的短期预警。
AI.method: 将病害预测重新定义为未来3-7天内进入风险期的事件预测；引入最小无病间隔以减少标签碎片化；构建包含湿度、降雨、温度及季节性周期编码的特征表示；并对比了XGBoost、LSTM和TCN等模型。
AI.result: 研究表明，基于事件的预测方法能有效支持短期风险预警，且不同模型在事件召回率、提前期和误报率之间表现出显著的权衡差异。
AI.conclusion: 基于事件的预测范式能够有效捕捉环境前兆，为葡萄园病害提供更具操作性的短期预警，证明了问题定义在环境时间序列分析中的核心作用。
AI.translation: 从环境观测中对葡萄园病害风险进行准确的早期预警对于及时干预和更可持续的作物保护至关重要。然而，许多现有研究将病害预测制定为每日状态分类，这可能偏向于持久性驱动的预测，并且仅能为可操作的短期预警提供有限的支持。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于事件的方法，用于从环境时间序列中对葡萄园病害风险进行早期预警，并通过一个葡萄园案例研究进行了评估。该任务被重新定义为预测未来3-7天窗口内进入带注释的风险期的转换，而不是预测每日的病害状态。为了减少由二进制标签中的短中断引起的碎片化，仅在最小无病间隔后才定义新事件。这种公式鼓励模型捕捉与即将到来的风险期相关的环境前兆，而不是仅仅复制时间持久性。利用多年农业气象数据，我们构建了输入表示，通过循环时间编码捕捉湿度动态、降雨累积、温度变异性和季节性结构。我们评估了来自经典机器学习和深度学习的代表性方法，包括XGBoost、长短期记忆（LSTM）网络和时间卷积网络（TCN），并使用了标准分类指标和面向事件的预警协议。结果表明，基于事件的公式支持实用的短期预警，而对比模型在事件召回率、提前期和虚警行为之间表现出明显的权衡。总的来说，这项研究强调了环境时间序列学习中问题定义的重要性，并展示了基于事件的预测在葡萄园病害预警系统中的价值。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于葡萄园病害风险预警的事件驱动方法。通过将预测目标从每日状态分类转变为未来3-7天内的风险事件预测，并优化标签定义以捕捉环境前兆，该方法在多年度农业气象数据上进行了验证，展示了其在提升预警实用性方面的潜力。
AI.keywords: 葡萄园病害, 事件驱动预警, 时间序列分析, 农业气象, 机器学习
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将传统的“每日状态分类”问题转化为“事件驱动的风险预警”问题。这种范式转移有效地解决了时间序列预测中常见的持久性偏差问题，更贴合农业实际生产中的决策需求。局限性在于该方法依赖于高质量标注的风险周期数据，且不同模型在召回率与虚警率之间的权衡仍是挑战。

title: Neural-Guided Domain Restriction to Accelerate Pseudospectra Computation for Structured Non-normal Banded Matrices
summary:
Computing pseudospectra of non-normal matrices is essential for understanding the stability and transient behavior of dynamical systems. Such analysis is critical in applications including fluid dynamics, control systems, and differential operators, where non-normality can lead to significant transient amplification and sensitivity to perturbations that are not captured by eigenvalue analysis alone. At large scales, commonly used numerical approaches for pseudospectra computation can become computationally demanding, as they require repeated auxiliary computations to identify spectrally sensitive regions in the complex plane.
  We present a neural network-based approach that predicts sensitive regions directly from matrix features, thereby avoiding exhaustive pseudospectra evaluation across the entire complex plane. We calibrate the prediction threshold on validation data to ensure reliable coverage of sensitive regions. The trained neural network guides the selection of grid points requiring full computation, enabling focused computation only where necessary. The approach provides a practical preprocessing strategy for efficient pseudospectra computation. Numerical experiments on non-normal banded matrices demonstrate substantial speedup compared to full grid-based numerical evaluation while maintaining high accuracy in identifying sensitive regions.

AI.title_translation: 神经引导的域限制方法：加速结构化非正态带状矩阵的伪谱计算
AI.tldr: 利用神经网络预测非正态矩阵的伪谱敏感区域，从而减少计算量并加速伪谱分析。
AI.motivation: 现有的大规模非正态矩阵伪谱计算方法计算量巨大，需要对整个复平面进行重复评估，导致效率低下。
AI.method: 提出一种基于神经网络的方法，利用矩阵特征直接预测复平面上的敏感区域，并对预测阈值进行校准，从而指导仅在必要区域进行网格点计算。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，该方法在保持高精度的同时，相比全网格数值评估，在带状非正态矩阵上实现了显著的计算加速。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功证明了利用神经网络引导计算可以显著降低伪谱计算的计算成本，为处理大规模非正态矩阵提供了一种高效的预处理策略。
AI.translation: 计算非正态矩阵的伪谱对于理解动力系统的稳定性和瞬态行为至关重要。这种分析在流体动力学、控制系统和微分算子等应用中至关重要，因为非正态性会导致显著的瞬态放大和对扰动的敏感性，而这些是单纯的特征值分析无法捕捉到的。在大规模情况下，常用的伪谱计算数值方法可能会变得计算量巨大，因为它们需要重复的辅助计算来识别复平面中的光谱敏感区域。我们提出了一种基于神经网络的方法，可以直接从矩阵特征预测敏感区域，从而避免在整个复平面上进行详尽的伪谱评估。我们在验证数据上校准预测阈值，以确保对敏感区域的可靠覆盖。训练好的神经网络指导选择需要进行全面计算的网格点，从而仅在必要时进行重点计算。该方法为高效的伪谱计算提供了一种实用的预处理策略。在非正态带状矩阵上的数值实验表明，与基于全网格的数值评估相比，该方法在识别敏感区域方面保持高精度的同时，实现了显著的加速。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于神经网络的预处理策略，通过预测非正态矩阵在复平面上的敏感区域，避免了对整个复平面的全网格伪谱评估，从而显著加速了计算过程。
AI.keywords: 伪谱, 非正态矩阵, 神经网络, 动力系统, 计算加速
AI.comments: 该论文将深度学习与经典数值分析相结合，通过预测敏感区域来加速伪谱计算，这是一种解决大规模矩阵计算瓶颈的创新思路。其局限性在于该方法似乎特定于带状矩阵，且模型预测的可靠性依赖于训练数据的覆盖范围。

title: The Newsworthiness of Brazilian Distress: A Peak Analysis on Time Series of International Media Attention to Disasters in Brazil
summary: Media coverage influences disaster response, yet the drivers of international media attention to local events remain unevenly understood. Brazil offers a compelling case: some of its natural and technological disasters occasionally hit the international headlines. However, systematic analyses of what makes these events be discussed abroad are still missing. Addressing this gap requires representative, validated and country-specific news datasets. This paper presents a peak analysis of 2k news about Brazilian fires and landslides in German newspapers from 2000 to 2024. Using time series segmentation to detect news event peaks, we examine the extent to which they can be temporally aligned with observations in national and global disaster databases.

AI.title_translation: 巴西灾害的新闻价值：巴西灾害国际媒体关注度时间序列的峰值分析
AI.tldr: 本文通过分析德国媒体对巴西火灾和滑坡的报道，揭示了国际媒体关注灾害事件的时间规律。
AI.motivation: 尽管媒体报道影响灾害响应，但国际媒体关注本地灾害的驱动因素尚不明确，且缺乏针对巴西灾害报道的系统性分析。
AI.method: 采用时间序列分段方法检测新闻事件峰值，并将其与国家及全球灾害数据库进行时间对齐分析。
AI.result: 通过对2000年至2024年间德国报纸中关于巴西火灾和滑坡的2000条新闻进行分析，量化了媒体关注度的峰值，并评估了其与实际灾害数据库的吻合程度。
AI.conclusion: 研究通过时间序列峰值分析，有效识别并量化了巴西灾害在德国媒体报道中的特征，为理解国际新闻报道的规律提供了实证依据。
AI.translation: 媒体报道影响灾害响应，但国际媒体对本地事件的关注驱动因素尚不完全清楚。巴西提供了一个引人注目的案例：其部分自然和技术灾害偶尔会登上国际头条。然而，关于这些事件为何在国外被讨论的系统性分析仍然缺失。填补这一空白需要具有代表性、经过验证且针对特定国家的新闻数据集。本文对2000年至2024年德国报纸中关于巴西火灾和滑坡的2000条新闻进行了峰值分析。通过使用时间序列分段来检测新闻事件峰值，我们考察了它们在多大程度上可以与国家和全球灾害数据库中的观测结果在时间上保持一致。
AI.summary: 本文通过分析2000-2024年德国媒体对巴西火灾和滑坡的报道，利用时间序列峰值分析法，探讨了巴西灾害事件如何转化为国际新闻关注点，并与实际灾害数据进行了比对。
AI.keywords: 新闻价值, 巴西灾害, 时间序列分析, 国际媒体报道, 峰值检测
AI.comments: 该研究填补了关于国际媒体对特定国家灾害关注度驱动因素研究的空白，通过时间序列分析将媒体报道与灾害数据库对接，具有较强的实证意义。其局限性在于仅局限于德国媒体及火灾与滑坡两类灾害。

title: InterMesh: Explicit Interaction-Aware End-to-End Multi-Person Human Mesh Recovery
summary: Humans constantly interact with their surroundings. Existing end-to-end multi-person human mesh recovery methods, typically based on the DETR framework, capture inter-human relationships through self-attention across all human queries. However, these approaches model interactions only implicitly and lack explicit reasoning about how humans interact with objects and with each other. In this paper, we propose InterMesh, a simple yet effective framework that explicitly incorporates human-environment interaction information into human mesh recovery pipeline. By leveraging a human-object interaction detector, InterMesh enriches query representations with structured interaction semantics, enabling more accurate pose and shape estimation. We design lightweight modules, Contextual Interaction Encoder and Interaction-Guided Refiner, to integrate these features into existing HMR architectures with minimal overhead. We validate our approach through extensive experiments on 3DPW, MuPoTS, CMU Panoptic, Hi4D, and CHI3D datasets, demonstrating remarkable improvements over state-of-the-art methods. Notably, InterMesh reduces MPJPE by 9.9% on CMU Panoptic and 8.2% on Hi4D, highlighting its effectiveness in scenarios with complex human-object and inter-human interactions.

title: Counter-Dyna: Data-Efficient RL-Based HVAC Control using Counterfactual Building Models
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) offers a promising approach for data-efficient energy management in buildings, combining the strengths of predictive modeling and reinforcement learning. While previous MBRL methods applied to HVAC control have reduced training data requirements, they still require several months of interaction with the building to learn a satisfactory control policy. A key reason is that existing surrogate models attempt to predict the entire state-space, including weather and electricity prices that are unaffected by control actions, or completely ignore these variables. Addressing these issues, we propose Counter-Dyna, a method that enhances the data-efficiency of Dyna, an MBRL method. We create data-efficient counterfactual surrogate models (CSM) by leveraging invariances in the state-space. Using a CSM in Dyna speeds up RL training measured in environment interaction data compared to previous results. In comparison with previous state-of-the-art that used 6-12 months of environment interactions, our method needs only 5 weeks. We evaluate our method in a large simulation study using the literature standard BOPTEST framework and proximal policy algorithm (PPO) as the RL algorithm. Our results show cost-saving potentials of 5.3% to 17.0% in a hypothetical deployment scenario. Our work is a significant step towards making real-world deployment of RL algorithms in HVAC control practically viable.

AI.title_translation: Counter-Dyna：基于反事实建筑模型的HVAC系统数据高效强化学习控制
AI.tldr: Counter-Dyna 通过构建反事实代理模型，将HVAC强化学习控制的训练数据需求从数月缩短至5周，同时实现显著节能。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）在HVAC控制中仍需要数月的环境交互数据，原因是代理模型试图预测所有状态（包括不受控制影响的天气和电价），导致学习效率低下。
AI.method: 提出 Counter-Dyna 方法，通过识别状态空间中的恒定性构建反事实代理模型（CSM），将其集成到 Dyna 架构中，并结合 PPO 算法进行训练。
AI.result: 该方法仅需5周的环境交互数据即可训练出满意的控制策略，相比现有方法（6-12个月）效率大幅提升，并在仿真中实现了5.3%至17.0%的节能效果。
AI.conclusion: Counter-Dyna 通过利用状态空间的恒定性构建反事实代理模型，极大地提升了HVAC控制中强化学习的样本效率，使其在现实场景中的应用更加可行。
AI.translation: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）为建筑节能管理提供了一种有前景的方法，结合了预测建模和强化学习的优势。尽管以往应用于HVAC控制的MBRL方法减少了训练数据需求，但它们仍需要数月的建筑交互来学习满意的控制策略。一个关键原因是现有的代理模型试图预测整个状态空间，包括不受控制动作影响的天气和电价，或者完全忽略了这些变量。针对这些问题，我们提出了 Counter-Dyna，这是一种增强 Dyna（一种MBRL方法）数据效率的方法。我们通过利用状态空间的恒定性来创建数据高效的反事实代理模型（CSM）。在 Dyna 中使用 CSM 可以加快强化学习训练，相较于以往的研究，减少了环境交互数据需求。与此前使用6-12个月环境交互的最先进方法相比，我们的方法仅需5周。我们在使用文献标准 BOPTEST 框架和近端策略优化（PPO）算法的大型仿真研究中评估了我们的方法。结果显示，在假设的部署场景中，其具有5.3%至17.0%的节能潜力。我们的工作是使强化学习算法在 HVAC 控制中的实际部署迈向可行性的重要一步。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 Counter-Dyna，一种旨在提升HVAC控制中强化学习数据效率的方法。通过构建利用状态空间恒定性的反事实代理模型（CSM），该方法消除了对无关变量（如天气、电价）的冗余建模，显著减少了训练所需的交互数据量。实验表明，该方法将训练时间缩短至5周，并能实现显著的节能潜力。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, HVAC控制, 反事实模型, 样本效率, 建筑节能
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入反事实代理模型（CSM）有效解决了建筑HVAC控制中模型预测冗余信息的问题，显著降低了强化学习对交互数据的需求。该方法将训练时间从数月缩短至数周，在实际部署可行性方面迈出了重要一步，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Benchmarking LLMs on the Massive Sound Embedding Benchmark (MSEB)
summary: The Massive Sound Embedding Benchmark (MSEB) has emerged as a standard for evaluating the functional breadth of audio models. While initial baselines focused on specialized encoders, the shift toward "audio-native" Large Language Models (LLMs) suggests a new paradigm where a single multimodal backbone may replace complex, task-specific pipelines. This paper provides a rigorous empirical evaluation of leading LLMs - including members from the Gemini and GPT families - across the eight core MSEB capabilities to assess their efficacy and audio-text parity. Our results indicate that while a significant modality gap persists regarding performance and robustness, the empirical evidence for an "optimal" modeling approach remains inconclusive. Ultimately, the choice between audionative and cascaded architectures depends heavily on specific use-case requirements and the underlying assumptions regarding latency, cost, and reasoning depth.

AI.title_translation: 在海量音频嵌入基准（MSEB）上对大语言模型进行基准测试
AI.tldr: 本文评估了主流大语言模型在音频任务上的表现，发现目前大模型尚无法完全替代专用架构，且不同架构的选择需根据实际应用场景权衡。
AI.motivation: 随着“音频原生”大语言模型的兴起，需要评估它们是否能够替代传统的、针对特定任务的音频处理流水线，并考察其音频-文本的对齐能力。
AI.method: 在包含八项核心能力的MSEB（Massive Sound Embedding Benchmark）基准上，对包括Gemini和GPT系列在内的领先大语言模型进行了严格的实证评估。
AI.result: 研究发现，当前大模型在音频处理的性能和鲁棒性方面仍存在显著的“模态差距”，且目前没有证据表明哪种建模方法（音频原生或级联架构）在所有场景下均占优。
AI.conclusion: 目前尚不存在单一的“最优”架构，音频原生模型与级联架构的取舍取决于具体的应用场景、延迟要求、成本预算及推理深度。
AI.translation: 海量音频嵌入基准（MSEB）已成为评估音频模型功能广度的标准。虽然最初的基准测试侧重于专用编码器，但向“音频原生”大语言模型（LLM）的转变暗示了一种新范式，即单一多模态主干网可能取代复杂的、特定于任务的流水线。本文对领先的LLM（包括Gemini和GPT系列成员）在八项核心MSEB能力上进行了严格的实证评估，以评估其功效和音频-文本对齐能力。我们的结果表明，虽然在性能和鲁棒性方面仍存在显著的模态差距，但关于“最优”建模方法的实证证据尚无定论。最终，音频原生架构和级联架构之间的选择在很大程度上取决于特定的用例需求以及对延迟、成本和推理深度的基本假设。
AI.summary: 本文在MSEB基准下对主流大语言模型进行了全面评估，旨在探讨其作为音频处理主干的有效性。研究表明，尽管大模型在音频理解方面取得进展，但与专用模型相比仍存在差距，且不同架构的适用性高度依赖于具体的业务需求。
AI.keywords: 音频大模型, MSEB, 多模态评估, 音频嵌入, 模态差距
AI.comments: 该论文通过在MSEB基准上评估主流LLM，揭示了当前多模态模型在音频理解任务上的局限性。其创新点在于将传统音频评估框架应用于大模型，强调了在实际应用中选择架构时需要权衡性能、成本与延迟，对多模态音频技术选型具有指导意义。

title: Efficient Geometry-Controlled High-Resolution Satellite Image Synthesis
comments: 2026 IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS)
summary: High-resolution satellite images are often scarce and costly, especially for remote areas or infrequent events. This shortage hampers the development and testing of machine learning models for land-cover classification, change detection, and disaster monitoring. In this paper, we tackle the problem of geometry-controlled high-resolution satellite image synthesis by adding control over existing pre-trained diffusion models. We propose a simple yet efficient method for controlling the synthesis process by leveraging only skip connection features using windowed cross-attention modules. Several previously established control techniques are compared, indicating that our method achieves comparable performance while leading to a better alignment with the geometry control map. We also discuss the limitations in current evaluation approaches, amplifying the necessity of a consistent alignment assessment.

AI.title_translation: 高效的几何控制高分辨率卫星图像合成
AI.tldr: 通过在扩散模型中加入简单的窗口交叉注意力模块，实现了对高分辨率卫星图像的高效几何控制合成。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率卫星图像获取成本高且稀缺，限制了遥感领域机器学习模型的发展，因此需要一种高效的图像合成方法来生成受几何约束的图像。
AI.method: 提出了一种利用窗口交叉注意力模块（windowed cross-attention modules）和预训练扩散模型跳跃连接特征（skip connection features）的几何控制方法。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在保持与现有技术相当的合成性能的同时，实现了与几何控制图更好的对齐效果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了仅利用跳跃连接特征结合窗口交叉注意力模块，即可实现对预训练扩散模型的高效几何控制，为解决遥感领域高分辨率图像数据匮乏问题提供了一种有效途径。
AI.translation: 高分辨率卫星图像往往稀缺且昂贵，特别是在偏远地区或罕见事件中。这种短缺阻碍了用于土地覆盖分类、变化检测和灾害监测的机器学习模型的开发和测试。在本文中，我们通过增加对现有预训练扩散模型的控制，解决了几何控制的高分辨率卫星图像合成问题。我们提出了一种简单而高效的方法，通过仅利用窗口交叉注意力模块的跳跃连接特征来控制合成过程。通过与几种先前建立的控制技术进行比较，表明我们的方法在实现相当性能的同时，与几何控制图的对齐效果更好。我们还讨论了当前评估方法中的局限性，强调了进行一致性对齐评估的必要性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种高效的几何控制卫星图像合成方法，通过在预训练扩散模型中引入基于跳跃连接特征的窗口交叉注意力模块，实现了对合成过程的精准几何约束，有效缓解了遥感领域高分辨率数据不足的问题。
AI.keywords: 卫星图像合成, 扩散模型, 几何控制, 遥感图像, 交叉注意力
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种轻量且高效的几何控制方法，通过利用预训练扩散模型的跳跃连接特征，实现了高质量卫星图像合成。其创新点在于简化了控制模块，并在几何对齐方面取得了优于现有技术的表现，这对数据稀缺的遥感领域具有重要意义。不过，论文也指出了当前评估方法的不一致性，这为后续研究指明了方向。

title: Beyond Static Best-of-N: Bayesian List-wise Alignment for LLM-based Recommendation
summary:
Large Language Models have revolutionized recommender systems (LLM4Rec) by leveraging their generative capabilities to model complex user preferences. However, existing LLM4Rec methods primarily rely on token-level objectives, making it difficult to optimize list-level and non-differentiable metrics (e.g., NDCG, fairness) that define actual recommendation quality. While Best-of-N (BoN) directly optimizes these metrics during inference, its high computational cost hinders real-world deployment. To address this, BoN Alignment aims to distill the search capability into the model itself, yet current approaches suffer from two critical limitations: (1) Indiscriminate Supervision, where the static reference fails to distinguish the relative quality of candidates exceeding its empirical range, leading to a loss of ranking guidance; and (2) Gradient Decay, where the effective supervision signal rapidly diminishes as the evolving policy improves, resulting in inefficient optimization.
  To overcome these challenges, we propose BLADE (Bayesian List-wise Alignment via Dynamic Estimation). Unlike static approaches, BLADE introduces a Bayesian framework that continuously updates the target distribution by fusing historical priors with dynamic evidence from the model's current rollouts. This mechanism constructs a self-evolving target that adapts to the model's growing capabilities, ensuring the training signal remains informative throughout the learning process. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that BLADE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Crucially, it breaks the static performance upper bound, achieving sustained gains in both ranking accuracy (Recall, NDCG) and complex list-wise metrics (Fairness, Diversity). The code is available via https://github.com/RegionCh/BLADE.

AI.title_translation: 超越静态Best-of-N：面向大语言模型推荐的贝叶斯列表式对齐
AI.tldr: BLADE通过贝叶斯动态目标更新，解决了LLM推荐中静态对齐方法的性能瓶颈与训练效率问题，实现了推荐效果的持续优化。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推荐系统多依赖token级目标，难以优化非微分的列表级指标；而Best-of-N计算成本过高，且现有的对齐方法存在监督分辨力不足（Indiscriminate Supervision）和梯度随模型进化而衰减（Gradient Decay）的问题。
AI.method: 提出BLADE（Bayesian List-wise Alignment via Dynamic Estimation）框架，通过贝叶斯方法融合历史先验与模型当前滚出的动态证据，构建随模型能力提升而自演进的训练目标，从而解决静态监督和梯度衰减问题。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，BLADE显著优于现有基线方法，在Recall、NDCG等排序指标以及公平性、多样性等复杂列表指标上均实现了持续提升，突破了静态性能上限。
AI.conclusion: BLADE通过构建动态更新的贝叶斯目标分布，成功解决了LLM推荐系统中的静态监督限制和梯度衰减问题，实现了推荐性能的持续优化。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）通过利用其生成能力建模复杂的用户偏好，彻底改变了推荐系统（LLM4Rec）。然而，现有的LLM4Rec方法主要依赖token级目标，难以优化定义实际推荐质量的列表级和不可微指标（如NDCG、公平性）。虽然Best-of-N（BoN）在推理过程中直接优化这些指标，但其高昂的计算成本阻碍了实际部署。为了解决这一问题，BoN对齐旨在将搜索能力蒸馏到模型本身，但当前方法存在两个关键限制：（1）无差别监督，即静态参考无法区分超出其经验范围的候选者的相对质量，导致排序指导丢失；（2）梯度衰减，即随着演进策略的改进，有效的监督信号迅速减弱，导致优化效率低下。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了BLADE（通过动态估计进行贝叶斯列表式对齐）。与静态方法不同，BLADE引入了一个贝叶斯框架，通过融合历史先验与模型当前滚出的动态证据，持续更新目标分布。这种机制构建了一个适应模型不断增长能力的自演进目标，确保训练信号在整个学习过程中保持信息量。在三个真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明，BLADE显著优于最先进的基线。至关重要的是，它打破了静态性能上限，在排序准确性（Recall、NDCG）和复杂的列表级指标（公平性、多样性）方面均实现了持续增长。代码可通过 https://github.com/RegionCh/BLADE 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了BLADE框架，旨在解决LLM推荐系统中Best-of-N方法的高成本问题及现有对齐技术的监督局限。通过引入贝叶斯动态更新机制，BLADE构建了能随模型能力演进的自适应训练目标，有效提升了推荐的排序准确性及多样性与公平性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 推荐系统, 贝叶斯对齐, 列表式优化, 自演进目标
AI.comments: 该研究针对LLM推荐系统中Best-of-N方法计算成本高且现有对齐方法存在监督局限的问题，提出了动态贝叶斯对齐框架。其创新点在于引入了自演进目标分布，有效解决了梯度衰减和静态监督不足的问题，在提升推荐性能的同时兼顾了公平性和多样性，具有很高的实用价值。

title: SAMIC: A Lightweight Semantic-Aware Mamba for Efficient Perceptual Image Compression
summary: Perceptual image compression focuses on preserving high visual quality under low-bitrate constraints. Most existing approaches to perceptual compression leverage the strong generative capabilities of generative adversarial networks or diffusion models, at the cost of substantial model complexity. To this end, we present an efficient perceptual image compression method that exploits the long-range modeling capability and linear computational complexity of state space models, with a particular focus on Mamba. Unlike existing methods that rely on an inherently fixed scanning order and consequently impair semantic continuity and spatial correlation, we develop a semantic-aware Mamba block (SAMB) to enable scanning guided by dynamically clustered semantic features, thereby alleviating the strict causality constraints and long-range information decay inherent to Mamba. Inspired by singular value decomposition, we design an SVD-inspired redundancy reduction module (SVD-RRM) that performs a low-rank approximation on the latent features by introducing a learnable soft threshold, leading to channel-wise redundancy information reduction. The proposed SAMB is integrated into both the encoder and decoder of the compression framework, whereas the SVD-RRM is incorporated only in the encoder. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method performs favorably against state-of-the-art approaches in terms of rate-distortion-perception tradeoff and model complexity. The source code and pretrained models will be available at https://github.com/Jasmine-aiq/SAMIC.

AI.title_translation: SAMIC：一种用于高效感知图像压缩的轻量级语义感知 Mamba
AI.tldr: SAMIC 结合 Mamba 和 SVD 技术，通过语义感知扫描和冗余缩减，实现了低复杂度下的高性能感知图像压缩。
AI.motivation: 现有的感知图像压缩方法多依赖生成式对抗网络或扩散模型，导致模型计算复杂度过高；同时，传统 Mamba 的固定扫描顺序限制了语义连续性和空间相关性。
AI.method: 提出了 SAMIC 框架，包含两个核心组件：1. 语义感知 Mamba 块 (SAMB)，通过动态聚类引导扫描以优化语义连续性；2. SVD 启发冗余缩减模块 (SVD-RRM)，利用低秩近似和可学习软阈值去除通道冗余。
AI.result: 实验表明，SAMIC 在率-失真-感知权衡和模型复杂度方面均优于当前最先进的图像压缩方法。
AI.conclusion: SAMIC 方法通过引入语义感知 Mamba 模块和 SVD 冗余缩减，在保持低计算复杂度的同时，实现了优于现有前沿方法的率-失真-感知性能权衡。
AI.translation: 感知图像压缩致力于在低比特率约束下保持高视觉质量。大多数现有的感知压缩方法利用生成对抗网络或扩散模型的强大生成能力，但付出了巨大的模型复杂性代价。为此，我们提出了一种高效的感知图像压缩方法，利用状态空间模型（特别是 Mamba）的长程建模能力和线性计算复杂度。与依赖固定扫描顺序并削弱语义连续性和空间相关性的现有方法不同，我们开发了一种语义感知 Mamba 块（SAMB），通过动态聚类的语义特征引导扫描，从而缓解了 Mamba 固有的严格因果约束和长程信息衰减。受奇异值分解的启发，我们设计了一个 SVD 启发式冗余缩减模块（SVD-RRM），通过引入可学习的软阈值对潜在特征进行低秩近似，从而实现通道级冗余信息的缩减。SAMB 被集成到压缩框架的编码器和解码器中，而 SVD-RRM 仅集成在编码器中。大量实验证明，我们的方法在率-失真-感知权衡和模型复杂度方面均优于最先进的方法。源代码和预训练模型将在 https://github.com/Jasmine-aiq/SAMIC 提供。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种高效的感知图像压缩方法 SAMIC，利用 Mamba 的线性计算特性，通过创新的语义感知扫描机制和 SVD 启发式冗余缩减模块，在降低计算开销的同时显著提升了图像压缩的视觉质量。
AI.keywords: 感知图像压缩, Mamba, 语义感知, 冗余缩减, 轻量化模型
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将状态空间模型（Mamba）应用于感知图像压缩，通过语义感知扫描机制和SVD启发的冗余缩减模块，成功平衡了模型复杂度和视觉质量，为轻量化高性能图像压缩提供了新思路。

title: RangeGuard: Efficient, Bounded Approximate Error Correction for Reliable DNNs
comments: 16 pages, 9 figures. Accepted to the 53rd Annual IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Computer Architecture (ISCA 2026)
summary:
As DRAM scales in density and adopts 3D integration, raw fault rates increase and multi-bit errors are no longer rare. Such errors can severely impact Deep Neural Networks (DNNs): although DNNs tolerate small numerical perturbations, random bit flips can create extreme outliers that propagate and sharply degrade accuracy. Large Language Models (LLMs) are particularly vulnerable because attention, residual, and normalization layers can amplify and preserve a single corrupted activation across many layers, destabilizing inference.
  This paper introduces RangeGuard, a metadata-centric error-correcting framework that provides strong reliability and high efficiency based on bounded approximate correction. Instead of protecting raw bits, RangeGuard encodes compact Range Identifiers (RIDs) that capture the numerical range of each value. These compact metadata enable efficient use of limited redundancy and concentrate protection on range changes, which indicate harmful semantic deviations, while ignoring benign intra-range variations. Upon detecting a range change, RangeGuard restores the correct range and substitutes a representative value, ensuring that error magnitudes are bounded within the range. Based on RIDs, RangeGuard can tolerate 64+ flipped bits using only 16 bits of parity available in GPU memories without a noticeable accuracy loss. By introducing semantic range protection, RangeGuard enables reliable DNN execution even under frequent memory errors and tight redundancy budgets.
comment: 16 pages, 9 figures. Accepted to the 53rd Annual IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Computer Architecture (ISCA 2026)

AI.title_translation: RangeGuard：面向可靠DNN的高效、有界近似纠错机制
AI.tldr: RangeGuard通过监控数值范围而非纠正所有比特错误，以极低的开销实现了DNN在严重内存故障下的高可靠性。
AI.motivation: 随着DRAM密度的增加，多位内存故障日益频繁。由于DNN（特别是LLM）中的注意力层和残差层会放大单点比特翻转带来的极端离群值，导致推理精度严重下降，现有的保护手段难以在高冗余要求下兼顾效率与可靠性。
AI.method: 引入RangeGuard框架，通过编码紧凑的范围标识符（RIDs）来捕获数值范围。在检测到范围偏差时，系统会恢复正确范围并替换为代表值，从而将错误幅度限制在可控范围内。
AI.result: 在仅使用GPU内存中16位奇偶校验位的情况下，RangeGuard能够容忍超过64位比特翻转，且不会导致明显的精度损失。
AI.conclusion: RangeGuard通过引入基于范围标识符（RIDs）的语义保护机制，成功在有限的内存冗余预算下，实现了对深度神经网络（特别是LLM）在多位内存错误下的鲁棒性保护，且几乎没有准确度损失。
AI.translation: 随着DRAM密度的扩展和3D集成的采用，原始故障率不断增加，多位错误已不再罕见。此类错误会严重影响深度神经网络（DNN）：尽管DNN对小的数值扰动具有容忍度，但随机比特翻转会产生极端的离群值，这些离群值会传播并急剧降低准确性。大语言模型（LLM）尤其脆弱，因为注意力层、残差层和归一化层可以放大并保留跨多个层的单个损坏激活值，从而导致推理不稳定。本文介绍了RangeGuard，这是一个以元数据为中心的纠错框架，基于有界近似纠错提供强大的可靠性和高效率。RangeGuard不是保护原始位，而是编码紧凑的范围标识符（RIDs），用以捕获每个值的数值范围。这些紧凑的元数据能够有效利用有限的冗余，并将保护集中在表示有害语义偏差的范围变化上，同时忽略良性的范围内波动。在检测到范围变化时，RangeGuard会恢复正确的范围并替换一个代表值，确保错误幅度被限制在范围内。基于RIDs，RangeGuard可以在仅使用GPU内存中可用的16位奇偶校验位的情况下，容忍64位以上的比特翻转，且不会产生明显的准确度损失。通过引入语义范围保护，RangeGuard即使在频繁的内存错误和严格的冗余预算下，也能实现可靠的DNN执行。
AI.summary: 本文提出了RangeGuard框架，通过为DNN数值编码紧凑的范围标识符（RIDs）进行语义级纠错。该方法通过限制错误导致的数值偏差范围，而非纠正每一个比特错误，从而在低开销条件下有效缓解了内存故障对DNN模型推理稳定性的影响。
AI.keywords: 深度神经网络, 内存错误, 范围标识符, 纠错机制, 错误边界控制
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地从数值语义而非底层位纠错的角度解决内存故障问题，通过利用DNN对数值扰动的容忍度，实现了高效率的错误缓解。其核心贡献在于将纠错重心从“精确恢复”转向“范围约束”，在极端错误场景下表现出极强的鲁棒性。

title: Practical validation of synthetic pre-crash scenarios
summary: The representativeness of synthetic pre-crash scenarios is crucial for assessing the safety impact of Driving Automation Systems through virtual simulations. However, a gap remains in the robust evaluation of synthetic pre-crash scenarios' practical equivalence to their real-world counterparts; that is, whether they are similar enough for the intended assessment purpose. Conventional significance testing is inadequate, as it focuses on detecting differences rather than establishing practical equivalence. This study addresses the research gap by extending our previous work on a Bayesian Region of Practical Equivalence (ROPE)-based equivalence testing framework by introducing a binning-based approach to define appropriate statistics and equivalence criteria. Two binning-based statistics are proposed to measure practically meaningful distributional differences between datasets in the context of safety impact assessment. The framework's applicability is demonstrated through a case study, which tests the practical equivalence of two synthetic rear-end pre-crash datasets with a previously developed reference dataset in the context of the safety impact assessment of an Automatic Emergency Braking system. The results show that the framework provides informative quantitative assessments of practical equivalence as well as diagnostic insights into the divergence of datasets. Although the demonstration focuses on rear-end pre-crash scenarios, the framework is generic and extensible to broader validation contexts, providing an interpretable and principled basis for practical equivalence assessment across diverse synthetic data applications.

AI.title_translation: 合成预碰撞场景的实际验证
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于贝叶斯ROPE和分箱技术的通用框架，用于定量评估虚拟仿真中合成预碰撞场景与真实场景的实际等效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的显著性检验方法侧重于检测差异而非建立实际等效性，无法满足自动驾驶系统虚拟仿真中对合成预碰撞场景代表性评估的需求。
AI.method: 引入了一种基于分箱（binning-based）的方法来定义统计量和等效性准则，并基于贝叶斯等效区域（ROPE）框架对合成数据集与参考数据集进行实际等效性测试。
AI.result: 案例研究表明，该框架不仅能提供合成数据集与参考数据集之间实际等效性的定量评估，还能识别数据集的具体差异，证实了其在自动驾驶紧急制动系统评估中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的基于分箱的贝叶斯ROPE框架能够有效评估合成预碰撞场景与真实数据的实际等效性，并能提供数据集差异的诊断见解，适用于更广泛的自动驾驶系统安全性验证场景。
AI.translation: 合成预碰撞场景的代表性对于通过虚拟仿真评估驾驶自动化系统的安全影响至关重要。然而，在评估合成预碰撞场景与其真实世界对应场景的实际等效性（即它们是否足以满足预期的评估目的）方面，仍存在差距。传统的显著性检验是不够的，因为它侧重于检测差异而不是建立实际等效性。本研究通过引入基于分箱的方法来定义适当的统计量和等效性准则，扩展了我们之前关于基于贝叶斯等效区域（ROPE）的等效性检验框架，从而解决了这一研究空白。提出了两种基于分箱的统计量，用于在安全影响评估的背景下测量数据集之间具有实际意义的分布差异。通过一个案例研究证明了该框架的适用性，该研究在自动紧急制动系统的安全影响评估背景下，测试了两个合成追尾预碰撞数据集与先前开发的参考数据集的实际等效性。结果表明，该框架提供了关于实际等效性的信息性定量评估，以及对数据集差异的诊断见解。尽管演示集中在追尾预碰撞场景，但该框架是通用的，可扩展到更广泛的验证环境，为跨不同合成数据应用的实际等效性评估提供了一个可解释和原则性的基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种评估合成预碰撞场景与真实世界场景实际等效性的新框架。通过引入基于分箱的统计方法和贝叶斯ROPE测试，研究人员能够定量判断合成数据在安全评估中的代表性。该方法在自动紧急制动系统的案例研究中表现出良好的诊断能力，且具备通用性和可扩展性。
AI.keywords: 虚拟仿真, 预碰撞场景, 贝叶斯等效区域, 自动驾驶系统, 安全性评估
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入贝叶斯等效区域（ROPE）框架和分箱统计方法，解决了虚拟仿真中合成场景与真实场景等效性评估的难题，为自动驾驶系统的安全性验证提供了一种定量且可解释的科学评估手段，具有很高的工程实用价值。

title: Delay-Aware Large-Small Model Collaboration over LEO Satellite Networks
summary: In this paper, we introduce a delay-aware largesmall model collaboration scheme for low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite networks, which can balance the computational load among satellites and the communication load across inter-satellite links. Specifically, computational resource constrained remote sensing satellites are responsible for data collection and local processing using small models, while collaborating with computing satellites that provide large model processing. To minimize the service delay, we formulate a joint optimization problem for offloading decision and routing strategy design, which is transformed into a decentralized partially observable Markov decision process. To solve the problem, we develop a multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL)-based algorithm with offline policy training and online bisection search. The offline trained policy determines routing strategies, while online bisection search iteratively adjusts the offloading decisions. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme can reduce the service delay by up to 31.85% compared with the benchmarks.

AI.title_translation: 面向低地球轨道卫星网络的延迟感知大小模型协同机制
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合多智能体强化学习的大小模型协同机制，通过优化LEO卫星网络的计算卸载与路由，成功将服务延迟降低了31.85%。
AI.motivation: 为了解决低地球轨道（LEO）卫星网络中计算资源受限、链路通信负载不均导致的业务服务延迟高的问题，旨在实现卫星间的计算与通信负载均衡。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于多智能体强化学习（MARL）的算法，包含线下策略训练（用于路由决策）和线上二分搜索（用于调整卸载决策），以解决去中心化部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，该方案与现有基准相比，能够将服务延迟降低高达31.85%。
AI.conclusion: 提出的协同方案通过优化计算卸载与路由策略，显著降低了LEO卫星网络中的服务延迟，验证了大小模型协作架构在卫星边缘计算中的有效性。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们为低地球轨道（LEO）卫星网络引入了一种延迟感知的大小模型协同方案，该方案可以平衡卫星间的计算负载和卫星间链路的通信负载。具体而言，计算资源受限的遥感卫星负责使用小模型进行数据收集和本地处理，同时与提供大模型处理的计算卫星进行协作。为了最小化服务延迟，我们制定了一个关于卸载决策和路由策略设计的联合优化问题，并将其转换为去中心化部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程。为了解决该问题，我们开发了一种基于多智能体强化学习（MARL）的算法，结合了离线策略训练和在线二分搜索。离线训练的策略决定路由策略，而在线二分搜索则迭代调整卸载决策。仿真结果表明，与基准方案相比，所提出的方案可以将服务延迟降低高达31.85%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种面向低地球轨道（LEO）卫星网络的延迟感知大小模型协同方案。该方案让资源受限的遥感卫星执行小模型本地处理，并协同计算卫星进行大模型分析。通过联合优化卸载决策与路由策略，利用MARL算法有效降低了整体服务延迟。
AI.keywords: LEO卫星网络, 大小模型协作, 服务延迟优化, 多智能体强化学习, 计算卸载
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将大模型和小模型协作机制引入LEO卫星网络，有效解决了计算资源受限与服务延迟之间的矛盾。通过将复杂的联合优化问题建模为去中心化POMDP并采用MARL算法求解，具有较强的实际应用价值。局限性在于未详述卫星间链路的动态拓扑稳定性对算法性能的影响。

title: Open-Source Image Editing Models Are Zero-Shot Vision Learners
summary:
Recent studies have shown that large generative models can solve vision tasks they were not explicitly trained for. However, existing evidence relies on closed-source models~(Veo~3, Nano Banana Pro) or requires task-specific instruction tuning, leaving open whether publicly available image-editing models possess zero-shot vision abilities out of the box.
  We conduct a systematic evaluation of three open-source image-editing models -- Qwen-Image-Edit, FireRed-Image-Edit, and LongCat-Image-Edit -- on dense visual prediction tasks \emph{without any fine-tuning}. We benchmark monocular depth estimation on NYUv2 and DIODE, surface normal estimation on NYUv2, and semantic segmentation on Cityscapes, covering both geometric and semantic scene understanding.
  Results show that open-source image-editing models exhibit non-trivial zero-shot visual understanding. On NYUv2 surface normals, FireRed-Image-Edit achieves a mean angular error of $17.69^\circ$, surpassing the fine-tuned Marigold ($20.86^\circ$) and matching the instruction-tuned Vision Banana ($17.78^\circ$) without any task-specific training. On NYUv2 depth estimation, LongCat-Image-Edit obtains $δ_1{=}0.822$ with affine alignment, and Qwen-Image-Edit leads on DIODE Indoor ($δ_1{=}0.868$). On Cityscapes semantic segmentation, Qwen-Image-Edit reaches 25.7 mIoU at the 19-class level and 49.5 mIoU at a coarser 7-category level. By comparing three independently trained editors, we test whether zero-shot vision ability is an emergent property of image-editing pretraining rather than a model-specific artifact. Code, evaluation scripts, and all results are publicly released to serve as a reproducible baseline for future work.

title: Dream-MPC: Gradient-Based Model Predictive Control with Latent Imagination
summary: State-of-the-art model-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches either use gradient-free, population-based methods for planning, learned policy networks, or a combination of policy networks and planning. Hybrid approaches that combine Model Predictive Control (MPC) with a learned model and a policy prior to leverage the advantages of both paradigms have shown promising results. However, these approaches typically rely on gradient-free optimization methods, which can be computationally expensive for high-dimensional control tasks. While gradient-based methods are a promising alternative, recent works have empirically shown that gradient-based methods often perform worse than their gradient-free counterparts. We propose Dream-MPC, a novel approach that generates few candidate trajectories from a rolled-out policy and optimizes each trajectory by gradient ascent using a learned world model, uncertainty regularization and amortization of optimization iterations over time by reusing previously optimized actions. Our results on 24 continuous control tasks show that Dream-MPC can significantly improve the performance of the underlying policy and can outperform gradient-free MPC and state-of-the-art baselines. We will open source our code and more at https://dream-mpc.github.io.

AI.title_translation: Dream-MPC：基于隐空间想象的梯度模型预测控制
AI.tldr: Dream-MPC 通过将梯度优化与隐空间想象结合，并配合不确定性正则化与动作复用，提升了模型预测控制在复杂任务中的效率与性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于MPC的强化学习方法多依赖计算昂贵的无梯度优化，而现有的梯度优化方法在复杂任务中表现往往不如无梯度法，缺乏高效的梯度利用机制。
AI.method: 提出 Dream-MPC：通过策略生成少量候选轨迹，利用学习到的世界模型进行梯度上升优化，引入不确定性正则化，并通过复用历史优化动作来平摊计算成本。
AI.result: 在24项连续控制任务中，Dream-MPC显著提升了基础策略的性能，并优于现有的无梯度MPC方法及其他SOTA基准。
AI.conclusion: Dream-MPC 通过结合梯度优化与隐空间想象，在连续控制任务中展现了优于现有梯度法和无梯度法MPC的性能，验证了该方案的高效性。
AI.translation: 最先进的基于模型的强化学习（RL）方法通常使用基于种群的无梯度规划方法、学习策略网络，或策略网络与规划的结合。结合模型预测控制（MPC）、学习模型和策略先验的混合方法已经显示出良好的结果。然而，这些方法通常依赖于无梯度优化方法，这对于高维控制任务来说计算成本很高。虽然基于梯度的方法是一个有前途的替代方案，但最近的研究实证表明，基于梯度的方法的表现往往不如无梯度的方法。我们提出了 Dream-MPC，这是一种新颖的方法，它从展开的策略中生成少数候选轨迹，并通过利用学习到的世界模型、不确定性正则化以及通过重用先前优化的动作来平摊随时间变化的优化迭代，对每条轨迹进行梯度上升优化。我们在 24 项连续控制任务上的结果表明，Dream-MPC 可以显著提高基础策略的性能，并且可以优于无梯度 MPC 和最先进的基准。我们将开源代码及更多信息发布在 https://dream-mpc.github.io。
AI.summary: Dream-MPC 是一种新型模型预测控制方法，它通过在学习到的世界模型中对策略生成的候选轨迹进行梯度优化，并结合不确定性正则化与动作重用技术，实现了比传统无梯度及现有梯度法更优的控制性能。
AI.keywords: 模型预测控制, 强化学习, 梯度优化, 隐空间模型, 连续控制
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将梯度优化引入到基于隐空间想象的MPC中，通过结合策略先验、不确定性正则化和动作重用，有效解决了梯度方法在复杂控制任务中表现不佳的问题，为模型预测控制提供了一种高效且高性能的新范式。

title: Lightning Unified Video Editing via In-Context Sparse Attention
summary: Video editing has evolved toward In-Context Learning (ICL) paradigms, yet the resulting quadratic attention costs create a critical computational bottleneck. In this work, we propose In-context Sparse Attention (ISA), the first near-lossless empirical sparse framework tailored for ICL video editing. Our design is grounded in two key insights: first, context tokens exhibit significantly lower saliency than source tokens; second, we theoretically prove and empirically validate that Query sharpness correlates with approximation error. Motivated by these findings, ISA implements an efficient pre-selection strategy to prune redundant context, followed by a dynamic query grouping mechanism that routes high-error queries to full attention and low-error ones to a computationally efficient 0-th order Taylor sparse attention. Furthermore, we build \textbf{\texttt{LIVEditor}} , a novel lightning video editing model via ISA and a proposed video-editing data pipeline that curated a 1.7M high-quality dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LIVEditor achieves a $\sim$60% reduction in attention-module latency while surpassing state-of-the-art methods across EditVerseBench, IVE-Bench, and VIE-Bench, delivering near-lossless acceleration without compromising visual fidelity.

AI.title_translation: 通过上下文稀疏注意力实现闪电般快速的视频编辑
AI.tldr: LIVEditor 引入了一种新的稀疏注意力机制，在保持高质量视频编辑效果的同时，将注意力模块的计算延迟降低了约 60%。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于上下文学习（ICL）的视频编辑方法面临二次注意力计算成本极高的瓶颈，限制了其在大规模应用中的效率。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为上下文稀疏注意力（ISA）的框架，包含上下文预筛选策略和动态查询分组机制（将高误差查询进行全注意力计算，低误差查询使用 0 阶泰勒稀疏注意力），并构建了 LIVEditor 模型及 1.7M 的高质量训练数据集。
AI.result: LIVEditor 在注意力模块延迟上实现了约 60% 的降低，并在多个基准测试（EditVerseBench、IVE-Bench、VIE-Bench）中超越了现有先进方法，且视觉保真度几乎无损失。
AI.conclusion: LIVEditor 通过引入 ISA 机制，成功实现了视频编辑在保持高质量的同时大幅降低计算开销，为高效视频生成模型的发展提供了新思路。
AI.translation: 视频编辑正朝着上下文学习（ICL）范式发展，然而由此产生的二次注意力成本造成了严重的计算瓶颈。在这项工作中，我们提出了上下文稀疏注意力（ISA），这是第一个专为 ICL 视频编辑定制的近乎无损的经验稀疏框架。我们的设计基于两个关键见解：首先，上下文标记的显著性明显低于源标记；其次，我们从理论上证明并经验性地验证了查询锐度与近似误差相关。受这些发现的启发，ISA 实施了一种高效的预筛选策略来剪枝冗余上下文，随后采用动态查询分组机制，将高误差查询路由到全注意力，将低误差查询路由到计算高效的 0 阶泰勒稀疏注意力。此外，我们构建了 LIVEditor，这是一种通过 ISA 和所提出的视频编辑数据流水线（策划了 1.7M 高质量数据集）实现的新型闪电视频编辑模型。大量实验表明，LIVEditor 在注意力模块延迟方面实现了约 60% 的降低，同时在 EditVerseBench、IVE-Bench 和 VIE-Bench 上超越了最先进的方法，在不损害视觉保真度的情况下提供了近乎无损的加速。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 LIVEditor，一个通过上下文稀疏注意力（ISA）机制优化的视频编辑模型。该方法通过预筛选冗余上下文并根据查询误差动态分配计算资源，显著提升了视频编辑的推理效率，在保证画质的前提下实现了显著的延迟降低。
AI.keywords: 视频编辑, 上下文学习, 稀疏注意力, 计算效率, 深度学习
AI.comments: 该论文通过理论推导（查询锐度与近似误差的关系）与工程优化（稀疏注意力机制）的结合，有效解决了视频编辑中上下文学习带来的计算瓶颈。其创新点在于将注意力机制动态化，在大幅降低计算延迟的同时保持了视觉质量，具有很高的实用价值。

title: PINSIGHT: A Comprehensive Threat Exploration of Domain-Adaptive Wi-Fi based PIN Code Inference
summary: Wi-Fi signals can be exploited by adversaries as a sensing side channel to eavesdrop on physical information. By monitoring propagation effects of radio waves within the victim's environment, attackers can remotely infer sensitive information. One particularly concerning example is PIN code inference, where the attacker faces the challenge of mapping Wi-Fi physical-layer channel estimations back into typed digits. While effective in their training environment, such attacks typically fail as soon as they are deployed in unseen environments. The current state-of-the-art attack, WiKI-Eve, attempts to overcome this problem using a deep-learning approach, reporting high PIN code inference accuracy independent of environments, devices, and users. While this suggests a significant real-world threat, it is not well understood how far the attack actually reaches, nor what its underlying generalization performance is based on. In this work, we close this gap by presenting PINSIGHT, a novel methodology that separates the effects of environmental variation and PIN code typing. This enables the first rigorous threat assessment of such attacks, evaluating their generalization capabilities and limitations. Our approach leverages a robotic typing platform that produces highly repeatable keystroke events across systematically varied environment changes [...]. This dataset constitutes the first benchmark for environment generalization in Wi-Fi PIN code inference attacks. Evaluating several state-of-the-art methods, we find that attacks generalize reliably across changes in the surrounding environment but degrade substantially when the channel's encoding of typing itself shifts - precisely the condition that defines a realistic attack scenario. We conclude that the reported performance of current state-of-the-art Wi-Fi PIN inference attacks is not representative of the actual real-world threat.

AI.title_translation: PINSIGHT：对基于域自适应Wi-Fi的PIN码窃听攻击的全面威胁探索
AI.tldr: 通过构建首个环境泛化基准测试，研究揭示了现有的Wi-Fi PIN码窃听攻击在真实复杂环境下的实际威胁远低于预期。
AI.motivation: 现有Wi-Fi PIN码窃听攻击（如WiKI-Eve）声称具有跨环境的鲁棒性，但对其泛化性能的真实边界及底层机制缺乏深入理解，亟需对其进行严谨的威胁评估。
AI.method: 提出PINSIGHT方法，通过机器人打字平台生成具有高度可重复性的击键事件，系统性地分离环境变化和PIN码输入特征，从而评估攻击方法的泛化能力与局限性。
AI.result: 研究发现，虽然攻击在环境变化下表现稳定，但当击键的信号编码方式发生偏移时，攻击性能会显著下降，证明了其在现实攻击场景下的脆弱性。
AI.conclusion: 现有最先进的Wi-Fi PIN码窃听攻击在现实环境中的性能被高估，其实际泛化能力在面临输入方式变化时会大幅下降，无法实现真正的环境无关性。
AI.translation: Wi-Fi信号可被攻击者利用作为物理信息窃听的传感侧信道。通过监控目标环境中无线电波的传播效应，攻击者可以远程推断敏感信息。PIN码窃听是一个特别令人担忧的例子，攻击者面临着将Wi-Fi物理层信道估计映射回已输入数字的挑战。尽管这些攻击在训练环境中有效，但一旦部署到未知环境，它们通常会失效。目前最先进的攻击方法WiKI-Eve试图使用深度学习方法解决这一问题，并报告了独立于环境、设备和用户的极高PIN码窃听准确率。虽然这表明存在重大的现实威胁，但人们并不清楚这种攻击的实际范围，也不清楚其底层泛化性能的基础。在这项工作中，我们提出了PINSIGHT，一种将环境变化和PIN码输入效应分离的新颖方法，填补了这一空白。这使得对此类攻击进行首次严谨的威胁评估成为可能，并评估了其泛化能力和局限性。我们的方法利用一个机器人打字平台，在系统性改变的环境下产生高度可重复的击键事件。该数据集构成了Wi-Fi PIN码窃听攻击中环境泛化的首个基准。通过评估几种最先进的方法，我们发现攻击在周围环境变化时表现可靠，但在信道对输入本身的编码发生偏移时性能大幅下降——这恰恰是定义现实攻击场景的条件。我们得出结论，目前最先进的Wi-Fi PIN码窃听攻击所报告的性能并不能代表实际的现实威胁。
AI.summary: 本文提出了PINSIGHT方法，旨在严谨评估Wi-Fi PIN码窃听攻击的环境泛化能力。通过使用机器人平台构建基准数据集，研究表明现有攻击方法对环境变化的适应性被高估，且在真实的输入场景变化下表现不佳。
AI.keywords: Wi-Fi感测, PIN码窃听, 环境泛化, 深度学习, 安全评估
AI.comments: 该研究通过科学的实验设计揭示了现有Wi-Fi PIN码窃听攻击在真实环境中的局限性。其创新点在于通过机器人平台构建了首个环境泛化基准数据集，打破了对现有攻击方法泛化能力的盲目乐观，为该领域的后续研究提供了严谨的评估框架。

title: From Parameter Dynamics to Risk Scoring : Quantifying Sample-Level Safety Degradation in LLM Fine-tuning
summary: Safety alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) is extremely fragile, as fine-tuning on a small number of benign samples can erase safety behaviors learned from millions of preference examples. Existing studies attempt to explain this phenomenon by comparing parameters and hidden states before and after fine-tuning, but overlook their dynamic evolution during fine-tuning. In this paper, we uncover a critical mechanism underlying safety degradation by analyzing parameter dynamics, where benign fine-tuning causes parameters to cumulatively drift toward danger-aligned directions, progressively undermining the model's safety. This finding suggests that samples contributing more to this drift has greater fine-tuning risks. Based on this insight, we propose a method of Sample-Level Quantification of Safety Degradation (SQSD), which quantifies the influence of each training sample on safety degradation. Specifically, SQSD computes continuous risk scores to samples by measuring their induced parameter updates' projection difference between danger and safety directions. Extensive experiments across multiple models and datasets demonstrate that SQSD effectively quantifies sample-level fine-tuning risks and exhibits strong transferability across model architectures, parameter scales, and parameter-efficient methods.

AI.title_translation: 从参数动态到风险评分：量化大语言模型微调中的样本级安全性退化
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了微调过程中参数向危险方向漂移会导致LLM安全性退化，并提出了一种名为SQSD的方法来量化训练样本的安全风险。
AI.motivation: 现有研究在分析LLM微调导致安全性退化时，多关注微调前后的静态参数或隐藏状态，忽视了微调过程中的动态演化。作者旨在揭示参数动态变化如何导致模型安全性被逐步破坏，并据此量化微调样本的潜在风险。
AI.method: 提出了一种样本级安全退化量化方法（SQSD）。该方法通过计算训练样本引起的参数更新在危险方向和安全方向上的投影差异，为每个训练样本分配连续的风险评分，以识别导致安全性退化的关键样本。
AI.result: 研究发现，良性样本的微调会导致模型参数累积性地向危险对齐方向漂移，从而削弱模型安全性。基于此设计的SQSD方法能够准确量化样本的微调风险。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明，SQSD能够有效量化微调样本带来的安全风险，且具有跨模型架构、参数规模和参数高效微调方法的强迁移能力。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）的安全对齐极其脆弱，因为在少量良性样本上的微调可能会抹除从数百万偏好示例中学到的安全行为。现有的研究试图通过比较微调前后的参数和隐藏状态来解释这种现象，但忽略了它们在微调过程中的动态演化。在本文中，我们通过分析参数动态揭示了安全性退化的关键机制，即良性微调导致参数累积地向危险对齐方向漂移，从而逐步削弱模型的安全性。这一发现表明，对这种漂移贡献更大的样本具有更大的微调风险。基于这一洞察，我们提出了一种样本级安全退化量化方法（SQSD），用于量化每个训练样本对安全性退化的影响。具体而言，SQSD通过测量样本诱导的参数更新在危险方向和安全方向上的投影差异，为样本计算连续的风险评分。在多个模型和数据集上的广泛实验表明，SQSD有效地量化了样本级的微调风险，并在模型架构、参数规模和参数高效方法中表现出强大的迁移能力。
AI.summary: 本文研究了大型语言模型微调过程中的安全性退化问题。研究发现，微调过程中的参数动态漂移是导致安全能力丧失的关键机制。为此，作者提出了SQSD方法，通过量化样本对参数漂移的贡献来评估其带来的安全风险，实验验证了该方法在不同模型和环境下的有效性与迁移性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 安全对齐, 微调, 参数动态, 风险量化
AI.comments: 本文创新性地从参数动态演化的视角解释了LLM微调中的安全性退化现象，而非仅仅关注静态参数变化。提出了一种可量化的风险评分方法（SQSD），不仅具有理论深度，而且在模型架构和训练方法上展现出良好的通用性，为提高微调过程的安全性提供了实用工具。

title: Mixed Finite Elements for Geometrically Exact Beams using Discontinuous Rotations and Discrete Curvature
summary: We propose a novel mixed finite-element formulation for geometrically exact (Simo--Reissner) beams that introduces the moment vector as additional independent field. The specific mixed form allows for an element-local, discontinuous approximation of rotations, which is key to a simple and efficient discretization framework. The concept of discrete curvature provides a mathematically consistent treatment of rotation discontinuities. For linear constitutive laws, the mixed form is derived via a Legendre transform of the curvature-related strain energy. Objectivity is retained at the discrete level by interpolating relative rotations through a multiplicative split of the rotation field; path-independence is inherent to the total Lagrangian setting and verified numerically. Several benchmarks demonstrate optimal rates of convergence and accuracy, irrespective of the beam's slenderness and order of approximation. Notably, the lowest-order element entirely avoids rotation interpolation by employing element-constant rotations only.

AI.title_translation: 基于非连续旋转和离散曲率的几何精确梁混合有限元法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的混合有限元框架，通过非连续旋转和离散曲率简化了几何精确梁的计算，在保持高精度的同时简化了低阶单元的实现。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决传统几何精确梁有限元模型在旋转场插值和处理复杂几何非线性时的复杂性与计算效率问题。
AI.method: 提出一种新的混合有限元公式，将力矩矢量作为独立的辅助场，采用单元内非连续的旋转近似，并利用离散曲率处理旋转不连续性，通过Legendre变换导出线性本构关系，并采用乘法分解保持客观性。
AI.result: 数值算例表明该方法具有最优的收敛速度和精度，能够处理不同长细比的梁，且最低阶单元成功实现了无需旋转插值的计算。
AI.conclusion: 提出的混合有限元方法能有效处理几何精确梁，具备最优收敛率，且在各种长细比下均表现稳定，尤其在简化低阶计算方面具有显著优势。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种针对几何精确（Simo--Reissner）梁的新型混合有限元公式，引入力矩矢量作为额外的独立场。这种特定的混合形式允许对旋转进行单元局部的、非连续的近似，这是实现简单高效离散化框架的关键。离散曲率的概念为旋转不连续性提供了数学上一致的处理方法。对于线性本构定律，混合形式是通过曲率相关应变能的Legendre变换导出的。通过旋转场的乘法分解插值相对旋转，在离散层面上保持了客观性；路径独立性在全拉格朗日设置中是固有的，并已通过数值验证。多个基准测试证明了最优的收敛率和精度，且不受梁的长细比和近似阶数的影响。值得注意的是，最低阶单元通过仅使用单元常数旋转，完全避免了旋转插值。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对Simo-Reissner几何精确梁的混合有限元方法，通过将力矩引入为独立场，允许单元内部旋转的不连续性，并利用离散曲率维持数学一致性，实现了高效且鲁棒的离散化框架。
AI.keywords: 几何精确梁, 混合有限元, 离散曲率, 非连续旋转, Simo-Reissner梁
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入离散曲率和非连续旋转，简化了几何精确梁模型的离散化过程，尤其是在低阶单元中完全避免了复杂的旋转插值，具有很高的计算效率和鲁棒性。

title: VL-UniTrack: A Unified Framework with Visual-Language Prompts for UAV-Ground Visual Tracking
summary: UAV-ground visual tracking (UGVT) aims to simultaneously track the same object from both the UAV and the ground view. However, existing two-stream methods suffer from isolated feature extraction and rely heavily on implicit appearance matching, which struggles to establish reliable correspondence under drastic view differences, leading to tracking unreliability. To address these limitations, we propose VL-UniTrack, a fully unified framework enhanced by visual-language prompts. By encoding features from both views within a single shared encoder, our method breaks the barrier of feature isolation to facilitate sufficient cross-view interaction. To overcome the ambiguity caused by relying solely on appearance matching, we design visual-language geometric prompting module, which fuses language descriptions with visual features to generate learnable prompts. These prompts are then fed into our prompt-guided cross-view adapter module to enable sufficient cross-view feature interaction and to guide the learning of view-specific feature representations. Furthermore, a confidence-modulated mutual distillation loss is proposed to regularize the training by mitigating noise propagation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the latest benchmark. The code can be downloaded in https://github.com/xuboyue1999/VL-UniTrack.git

AI.title_translation: VL-UniTrack：用于无人机-地面视觉跟踪的视觉-语言提示统一框架
AI.tldr: VL-UniTrack通过视觉-语言提示和统一的跨视角适配器，显著提升了无人机与地面视角下目标跟踪的鲁棒性和精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的无人机-地面视觉跟踪方法存在跨视角特征提取隔离、依赖隐式外观匹配导致在巨大视角差异下跟踪不可靠的问题。
AI.method: 提出VL-UniTrack框架，采用共享编码器消除特征隔离；设计视觉-语言几何提示模块融合语义信息；引入提示引导的跨视角适配器模块进行交互；使用置信度调制的互蒸馏损失函数优化训练。
AI.result: 在最新基准测试中表现优异，实现了最先进的跟踪性能。
AI.conclusion: VL-UniTrack通过统一的框架和视觉-语言提示机制，有效解决了跨视角特征隔离和外观匹配模糊的问题，在UAV-地面跟踪任务中达到了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 无人机-地面视觉跟踪 (UGVT) 旨在同时从无人机和地面视角跟踪同一目标。然而，现有的双流方法存在特征提取孤立的问题，且过度依赖隐式外观匹配，在巨大的视角差异下难以建立可靠的对应关系，导致跟踪不可靠。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了 VL-UniTrack，这是一个由视觉-语言提示增强的完全统一框架。通过在单个共享编码器中编码来自两个视角的特征，我们的方法打破了特征隔离的障碍，以促进充分的跨视角交互。为了克服仅依赖外观匹配引起的歧义，我们设计了视觉-语言几何提示模块，该模块将语言描述与视觉特征融合以生成可学习的提示。这些提示随后被输入到我们的提示引导的跨视角适配器模块中，以实现充分的跨视角特征交互并指导视角特定特征表示的学习。此外，我们提出了一种置信度调制的互蒸馏损失，通过减轻噪声传播来规范化训练。大量实验表明，我们的方法在最新基准测试上达到了最先进的性能。代码可在 https://github.com/xuboyue1999/VL-UniTrack.git 下载。
AI.summary: VL-UniTrack是一个针对无人机-地面协同跟踪的统一框架，通过共享编码器打破特征隔离，并利用视觉-语言提示和几何提示模块增强跨视角特征交互与表示能力，有效提升了复杂视角下的跟踪可靠性。
AI.keywords: 无人机-地面视觉跟踪, 视觉-语言提示, 跨视角交互, 统一框架, 特征对齐
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入了视觉-语言提示（Visual-Language Prompts）来解决无人机-地面视角差异带来的跟踪难题，将多模态信息融合引入到视觉跟踪任务中，具有很高的研究价值和实际应用意义。

title: Benchmarking POS Tagging for the Tajik Language: A Comparative Study of Neural Architectures on the TajPersParallel Corpus
summary:
This paper presents the first benchmark for the task of automatic part-of-speech (POS) tagging for the Tajik language. Despite the existence of multilingual language models demonstrating high effectiveness for many of the world's languages, their capacity for grammatical analysis of Tajik has remained unexplored until now. The aim of this study is to fill this gap through a systematic comparison of classical neural network architectures and modern multilingual transformers.
  Experiments were conducted on the TajPersParallel corpus, a parallel lexical resource comprising approximately 44,000 dictionary entries. Due to the absence of full-fledged example sentences in the current version of the corpus, the task was performed at the level of isolated lexical units, representing a challenging case of context-independent classification. The study compares the following architectures: a recurrent BiLSTM-CRF model, as well as multilingual models XLM-RoBERTa (large), mBERT, ParsBERT (Persian), and ruBERT (Russian), adapted using the parameter-efficient fine-tuning method LoRA.
  The testing results showed that the best performance is achieved by the mBERT + LoRA model (macro F1-score = 0.11, weighted F1-score = 0.62). It was established that in the absence of syntactic context, all models experience significant difficulty in resolving morphological ambiguity, successfully classifying primarily high-frequency classes ("noun," "adjective") while demonstrating zero effectiveness for rare function words. Zero-shot evaluation revealed the greatest typological proximity of Tajik to Persian (ParsBERT) and Russian (ruBERT). The obtained results form a foundation for further research and development in the field of automatic processing of the Tajik language.

AI.title_translation: 塔吉克语词性标注基准测试：基于TajPersParallel语料库的神经架构对比研究
AI.tldr: 本文首次对塔吉克语词性标注进行了基准研究，发现mBERT+LoRA模型效果最佳，但也揭示了在缺乏上下文的情况下模型处理形态歧义的局限性。
AI.motivation: 填补塔吉克语自动词性标注研究的空白，探索多语言模型在塔吉克语语法分析中的有效性。
AI.method: 在TajPersParallel语料库上对BiLSTM-CRF、XLM-RoBERTa、mBERT、ParsBERT和ruBERT等模型进行对比实验，并采用LoRA进行参数高效微调。
AI.result: mBERT + LoRA模型表现最佳（加权F1分数为0.62）。所有模型在处理形态歧义和稀有功能词时均面临显著困难。零样本评估显示塔吉克语与波斯语和俄语最为接近。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了塔吉克语词性标注的基准，指出在缺乏上下文的情况下模型性能受限，并证实了塔吉克语与波斯语和俄语在语言学上的紧密关联。
AI.translation: 本文提出了塔吉克语自动词性标注（POS）任务的第一个基准。尽管多语言语言模型在许多世界语言中表现出高效，但它们对塔吉克语语法分析的能力此前一直未被探索。本研究旨在通过系统比较经典神经网络架构和现代多语言Transformer来填补这一空白。实验在TajPersParallel语料库上进行，这是一个包含约44,000个词典条目的平行词汇资源。由于当前版本的语料库缺乏完整的例句，任务是在孤立词汇单元层面执行的，这代表了上下文无关分类的一个挑战性案例。研究比较了以下架构：循环BiLSTM-CRF模型，以及使用参数高效微调方法LoRA适配的多语言模型XLM-RoBERTa (large)、mBERT、ParsBERT（波斯语）和ruBERT（俄语）。测试结果表明，mBERT + LoRA模型取得了最佳性能（宏F1分数=0.11，加权F1分数=0.62）。研究确定，在缺乏句法上下文的情况下，所有模型在解决形态歧义方面都经历了重大困难，主要成功分类了高频类别（“名词”、“形容词”），而对稀有功能词的有效性为零。零样本评估揭示了塔吉克语与波斯语（ParsBERT）和俄语（ruBERT）在类型学上的最大接近度。所得结果为塔吉克语自动处理领域的进一步研究和开发奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 本文对塔吉克语词性标注进行了首次基准测试，通过对比多种神经架构（包括BiLSTM-CRF和预训练多语言Transformer），在TajPersParallel语料库上评估了其在孤立词汇分类任务中的表现，为塔吉克语自然语言处理奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: 塔吉克语, 词性标注, 神经架构, 迁移学习, LoRA
AI.comments: 该研究是塔吉克语词性标注的首个基准测试，具有开创性意义。其局限在于语料库缺乏句子上下文，导致分类任务在孤立词汇层面进行，模型表现受限，特别是对稀有功能词的识别能力较弱。

title: GTF: Omnidirectional EPI Transformer for Light Field Super-Resolution
summary: Light field (LF) image super-resolution benefits from Epipolar Plane Images (EPIs), whose line slopes explicitly encode disparity. However, existing Transformer-based LF SR methods mainly attend to horizontal and vertical EPIs, leaving diagonal epipolar geometry underexplored. We present GTF, an omnidirectional EPI Transformer that explicitly models horizontal, vertical, 45-degree, and 135-degree EPIs within a unified reconstruction framework. GTF combines directional EPI processing, MacPI-based prior injection, adaptive directional fusion, and a topology-preserving feed-forward network to better exploit LF geometry. For the NTIRE 2026 fidelity tracks, we use GTF as the main model, while a lightweight GTF-Tiny variant targets the efficiency track. On five standard LF SR benchmarks covering both real-captured and synthetic scenes, GTF reaches 32.78 dB without inference-time enhancement, and stronger inference settings with EPSW and test-time augmentation further improve performance. Under the NTIRE 2026 efficiency constraint, GTF-Tiny attains 32.57 dB with only 0.915M parameters and 19.81 GFLOPs. In the NTIRE 2026 Light Field Image Super-Resolution Challenge, our submissions rank 3rd on Track 1 and Track 3 and 4th on Track 2. Architecture-evolution, channel-width, and inference analyses further support the effectiveness of diagonal EPI modeling, directional fusion, and the lightweight design.

title: TajikNLP: An Open-Source Toolkit for Comprehensive Text Processing of Tajik (Cyrillic Script)
summary: The Tajik language, written in Cyrillic script, remains severely under-resourced in terms of publicly available natural language processing (NLP) toolkits, hindering both linguistic research and applied development. This paper introduces TajikNLP, an open-source Python library that provides the first comprehensive pipeline for processing authentic Tajik text while preserving the original Cyrillic orthography. The library implements a modular architecture centered around a unified Doc object, enabling sequential application of components for cleaning, normalization, tokenization (including subword BPE), morphemic segmentation, part-of-speech tagging, stemming, lemmatization, and sentence splitting. A novel unified morphology engine is introduced, offering controlled and deep analysis modes that significantly improve handling of Tajik's agglutinative nominal and verbal inflections. The release further incorporates a lexicon-based sentiment analyser and pre-trained Word2Vec/FastText embeddings loaded directly from the Hugging Face Hub. To ensure reproducibility and facilitate future research, four accompanying linguistic datasets -- a POS-tagged corpus (52.5k entries), a sentiment lexicon (3.5k entries), a toponym gazetteer (5.6k entries), and a personal names dataset (3.8k entries) -- have been openly published under permissive licenses. The library's reliability is validated by an extensive test suite of 616 automated tests achieving 93% source code coverage. TajikNLP thus establishes a foundational technological infrastructure for Tajik language processing, lowering the barrier to entry for both academic and industrial applications in low-resource Cyrillic-script environments.

AI.title_translation: TajikNLP：一个用于塔吉克语（西里尔字母）综合文本处理的开源工具包
AI.tldr: TajikNLP是首个针对塔吉克语的全面开源NLP工具包，提供了包括形态分析在内的完整处理流程及配套数据集，有效解决了塔吉克语NLP资源匮乏的问题。

AI.result: TajikNLP成功实现了包括分词、词性标注、形态分析、词干提取等在内的全流程文本处理，代码测试覆盖率达93%，并开源了四个关键的语言学数据集。
AI.conclusion: TajikNLP 为塔吉克语处理提供了一个全面、可靠且开源的基础架构，极大地促进了该语言在学术研究和工业应用中的发展。
AI.translation: 塔吉克语（使用西里尔字母书写）在公开可用的自然语言处理（NLP）工具包方面仍然严重缺乏资源，这阻碍了语言学研究和应用开发。本文介绍了TajikNLP，这是一个开源的Python库，它提供了第一个用于处理真实塔吉克语文本的综合管线，同时保留了原始的西里尔字母拼写。该库实现了一个以统一Doc对象为中心的模块化架构，能够按顺序应用清洗、归一化、分词（包括子词BPE）、词素分割、词性标注、词干提取、词形还原和句子拆分等组件。文中引入了一种新颖的统一形态引擎，提供受控和深度分析模式，显著改善了对塔吉克语黏着名词和动词屈折变化的处理。该版本还整合了一个基于词典的情感分析器，并直接从Hugging Face Hub加载预训练的Word2Vec/FastText嵌入。为了确保可重复性并促进未来研究，四个配套的语言学数据集——一个词性标注语料库（52.5k条目）、一个情感词典（3.5k条目）、一个地名地名录（5.6k条目）和一个个人姓名数据集（3.8k条目）——已在许可协议下公开。该库的可靠性通过包含616个自动化测试的广泛测试套件进行了验证，实现了93%的源代码覆盖率。因此，TajikNLP为塔吉克语处理建立了基础的技术基础设施，降低了低资源西里尔字母环境下学术和工业应用的准入门槛。
AI.summary: TajikNLP是一个开源的Python库，旨在为使用西里尔字母的塔吉克语提供全面的文本处理管线。它支持从清洗、分词到形态分析和情感分析等多种功能，并配套发布了多个语言学数据集，为塔吉克语的NLP研究与应用构建了坚实的基础设施。

title: IntenBot: Flexible and Imprecise Multimodal Input for LLMs to Understand User Intentions for Casual and Human-Like HRI
summary: In natural human-to-human communication, multimodal user input is typically used to supplement explicit and complement implicit voice commands, with casualness allowing for flexible input modality combinations and tolerance for imprecise input data. For example, saying "I want that." with a casual glance at a bottle of water is clear enough in human-to-human communication as an implicit voice command accompanied by gaze and/or gestures, rather than an explicit one. To enable such a human-like interaction in human-robot interaction (HRI), we propose a system, IntenBot, to understand user intentions from flexible and imprecise multimodal input, including voice, gaze, and finger-pointing, in XR. The disambiguation capability of large language models (LLMs) is used to filter out irrelevant input modalities and imprecise input data, generating potential instructions for user confirmation. The flexible and imprecise multimodal input enables casual, human-like interaction with robots, reducing time, effort, and attention, and could also be used as non-voice input. We conducted an informative user behavior study in a simulated environment to understand users' natural be- havior in flexibly interacting with a robot using multimodal input and to obtain appropriate angle range parameters for gaze and finger-pointing. An XR study was then performed to evaluate the performance of IntenBot, compared with other methods. We also deployed IntenBot on a physical robot to showcase its real-world applications.
