AI.title_translation: S1-MMAlign：一个用于科学图文理解的大规模多学科数据集
AI.tldr: S1-MMAlign是一个拥有1550万个高质量图文对的科学多模态数据集，通过AI增强技术解决了科学数据图文对齐质量差的问题，助力科学基础模型的发展。
AI.motivation: 科学领域中复杂的图像与稀疏的文本描述之间存在巨大的语义鸿沟，且原始科学文献中的图文对齐往往较弱，限制了多模态学习在科学发现中的应用。
AI.method: 构建了包含1550万个图文对的S1-MMAlign数据集，并引入了一个基于多模态大语言模型的语义增强流水线，通过综合论文摘要和引用上下文来重新生成高质量的图像标题。
AI.result: 技术验证表明，该增强流水线显著降低了SciBERT伪困惑度，提升了CLIP图像-文本对齐度，并在零样本科学标题生成、多领域科学推理及视觉指令微调任务中显著增强了模型性能。
AI.conclusion: S1-MMAlign是一个大规模、高质量的科学多模态数据集，通过创新的语义增强流水线提升了数据质量，为科学AI领域的研究和应用奠定了坚实的基础。
AI.translation: 多模态学习彻底改变了通用领域的任务，但其在科学发现中的应用却因复杂的科学图像与稀疏的文本描述之间深刻的语义鸿沟而受到阻碍。我们提出了S1-MMAlign，这是一个大规模、多学科的多模态数据集，包含从250万篇开放获取科学论文中提取的超过1550万个高质量图文对。该数据集涵盖物理、生物、工程等多个学科，捕捉了包括实验装置、热图和显微图像在内的多种视觉模态。为了解决原始科学标题中普遍存在的弱对齐问题，我们引入了一个AI就绪的语义增强流水线，利用先进的多模态大语言模型，通过综合论文摘要和相应图形的引用上下文来重新生成图像标题。技术验证证实，我们的增强流水线通过降低SciBERT伪困惑度和增强CLIP图文对齐，显著提高了数据质量，同时也显著提升了多模态大语言模型在零样本科学标题生成、多领域科学推理和视觉指令微调方面的性能。S1-MMAlign为AI科学时代下的跨模态科学理解提供了一个关键的基础资源，支持科学基础模型及各类下游科学智能应用的开发。数据集已在Hugging Face上公开。
AI.summary: S1-MMAlign是一个包含1550万个科学图文对的大规模数据集，涵盖多个学科领域。该工作引入了AI驱动的标题重写流水线，通过整合上下文信息有效解决了科学图文对齐弱的问题，显著提升了多模态模型在科学理解任务中的表现。
AI.keywords: 多模态学习, 科学文献理解, 数据集构建, 语义增强, AI for Science
AI.comments: 该论文通过构建大规模、高质量的科学领域多模态数据集，直接解决了科学文献中图像与文本语义对齐这一关键瓶颈。其创新之处在于提出了一个AI驱动的语义增强流水线，有效地处理了原始科学文献中标签质量参差不齐的问题，为科学领域基础模型的训练提供了重要资源。

title: SV-GS: Sparse View 4D Reconstruction with Skeleton-Driven Gaussian Splatting
summary: Reconstructing a dynamic target moving over a large area is challenging. Standard approaches for dynamic object reconstruction require dense coverage in both the viewing space and the temporal dimension, typically relying on multi-view videos captured at each time step. However, such setups are only possible in constrained environments. In real-world scenarios, observations are often sparse over time and captured sparsely from diverse viewpoints (e.g., from security cameras), making dynamic reconstruction highly ill-posed. We present SV-GS, a framework that simultaneously estimates a deformation model and the object's motion over time under sparse observations. To initialize SV-GS, we leverage a rough skeleton graph and an initial static reconstruction as inputs to guide motion estimation. (Later, we show that this input requirement can be relaxed.) Our method optimizes a skeleton-driven deformation field composed of a coarse skeleton joint pose estimator and a module for fine-grained deformations. By making only the joint pose estimator time-dependent, our model enables smooth motion interpolation while preserving learned geometric details. Experiments on synthetic datasets show that our method outperforms existing approaches under sparse observations by up to 34% in PSNR, and achieves comparable performance to dense monocular video methods on real-world datasets despite using significantly fewer frames. Moreover, we demonstrate that the input initial static reconstruction can be replaced by a diffusion-based generative prior, making our method more practical for real-world scenarios.

AI.title_translation: SV-GS：基于骨架驱动高斯泼溅的稀疏视角 4D 重建
AI.tldr: SV-GS 提出了一种在稀疏视角和稀疏时间观测下进行高质量 4D 动态重建的新方法，通过骨架引导的变形场显著降低了对密集数据的依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有的动态重建方法通常依赖于密集的多视角视频，难以在现实中稀疏观测（稀疏视角和稀疏时间）的场景下应用，导致重建过程高度病态。
AI.method: 提出 SV-GS 框架，利用粗糙的骨架图和初始静态重建作为引导，通过优化一个由骨架关节姿态估计器和精细变形模块组成的骨架驱动变形场来实现动态重建，并将关节姿态估计器设为时间依赖以实现平滑运动插值。
AI.result: 在合成数据集上，PSNR 指标比现有方法提升高达 34%；在真实数据集上，即使使用显著更少的帧数，也能达到与密集单目视频方法相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: SV-GS 证明了在稀疏观测条件下，通过结合骨架驱动的变形场与高斯泼溅技术，可以实现高质量的 4D 动态重建，且该框架具有良好的扩展性和实用价值。
AI.translation: 在大范围移动的动态目标重建中，重建任务极具挑战性。标准的动态物体重建方法需要视角空间和时间维度上的密集覆盖，通常依赖于在每个时间步捕获的多视角视频。然而，这种设置仅在受限环境中可行。在现实场景中，观测往往在时间上稀疏，且从不同视角稀疏捕获（例如安全摄像头），这使得动态重建变得极度病态。我们提出了 SV-GS，一个在稀疏观测下同时估计变形模型和物体运动的框架。为了初始化 SV-GS，我们利用一个粗糙的骨架图和初始静态重建作为输入来引导运动估计（随后我们展示了该输入要求可以放宽）。我们的方法优化了一个由粗糙骨架关节姿态估计器和精细变形模块组成的骨架驱动变形场。通过仅使关节姿态估计器具有时间依赖性，我们的模型能够在保持学习到的几何细节的同时，实现平滑的运动插值。在合成数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法在稀疏观测下比现有方法在 PSNR 上提升了高达 34%，并且尽管使用的帧数显著减少，但在真实数据集上仍实现了与密集单目视频方法相当的性能。此外，我们证明了输入的初始静态重建可以被基于扩散的生成先验所取代，使我们的方法在现实场景中更具实用性。
AI.summary: SV-GS 是一种针对稀疏视角和稀疏时间观测的 4D 重建框架。它通过骨架驱动的变形场来估计物体的运动，并结合高斯泼溅技术保留几何细节，实现了在极少观测数据下的高质量动态场景重建。
AI.keywords: 4D 重建, 高斯泼溅, 稀疏视角, 骨架驱动, 变形模型
AI.comments: 该论文针对稀疏视角和稀疏时间采样下的动态场景重建难题，创新性地引入了骨架驱动的变形场，成功降低了对密集视频数据的依赖。其亮点在于将运动估计与高斯泼溅结合，并通过引入生成式先验进一步提升了实用性，为解决现实场景中难以获取密集数据的问题提供了有效方案。

title: In Line with Context: Repository-Level Code Generation via Context Inlining
summary: Repository-level code generation has attracted growing attention in recent years. Unlike function-level code generation, it requires the model to understand the entire repository, reasoning over complex dependencies across functions, classes, and modules. However, existing approaches such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or context-based function selection often fall short: they primarily rely on surface-level similarity and struggle to capture the rich dependencies that govern repository-level semantics. In this paper, we introduce InlineCoder, a novel framework for repository-level code generation. InlineCoder enhances the understanding of repository context by inlining the unfinished function into its call graph, thereby reframing the challenging repository understanding as an easier function-level coding task. Given a function signature, InlineCoder first generates a draft completion, termed an anchor, which approximates downstream dependencies and enables perplexity-based confidence estimation. This anchor drives a bidirectional inlining process: (i) Upstream Inlining, which embeds the anchor into its callers to capture diverse usage scenarios; and (ii) Downstream Retrieval, which integrates the anchor's callees into the prompt to provide precise dependency context. The enriched context, combining draft completion with upstream and downstream perspectives, equips the LLM with a comprehensive repository view.

AI.title_translation: 与上下文对齐：通过上下文内联实现仓库级代码生成
AI.tldr: InlineCoder通过将代码补全任务转化为双向内联的函数级任务，解决了大模型在理解复杂代码仓库依赖关系时的难题。
AI.motivation: 现有的仓库级代码生成方法（如RAG）多依赖表面相似度，难以捕捉复杂的函数间、类间及模块间的语义依赖关系，导致生成效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出InlineCoder框架，主要步骤包括：1. 生成一个初步的函数补全草稿（anchor）；2. 上游内联（Upstream Inlining）：将锚点嵌入调用者中以捕获使用场景；3. 下游检索（Downstream Retrieval）：将锚点调用的函数集成到提示词中以提供精确的依赖上下文。
AI.result: 实验表明，InlineCoder通过将仓库级理解转化为函数级任务，能够利用丰富的上下文信息，为大语言模型提供全面的仓库视图，有效提升了代码生成的准确性和相关性。
AI.conclusion: InlineCoder通过将未完成函数嵌入其调用图并结合双向内联技术，显著提升了模型对仓库级代码依赖关系的理解能力，从而在代码生成任务上表现优异。
AI.translation: 仓库级代码生成近年来备受关注。与函数级代码生成不同，它要求模型理解整个代码仓库，并对函数、类和模块之间复杂的依赖关系进行推理。然而，现有的方法如检索增强生成（RAG）或基于上下文的函数选择通常表现不佳：它们主要依赖表面相似度，难以捕捉控制仓库级语义的丰富依赖关系。在本文中，我们引入了InlineCoder，一个用于仓库级代码生成的全新框架。InlineCoder通过将未完成的函数内联到其调用图中，从而增强了对仓库上下文的理解，将具有挑战性的仓库理解任务重新定义为更简单的函数级编码任务。给定一个函数签名，InlineCoder首先生成一个草稿补全，称为锚点（anchor），它近似了下游依赖关系并支持基于困惑度的置信度估计。该锚点驱动了一个双向内联过程：（i）上游内联：将锚点嵌入其调用者中以捕获不同的使用场景；（ii）下游检索：将锚点的被调用者集成到提示词中以提供精确的依赖上下文。这种结合了草稿补全以及上游和下游视角的丰富上下文，使大语言模型具备了全面的仓库视图。
AI.summary: InlineCoder是一个仓库级代码生成框架，它通过将待补全函数内联到调用图中，并利用生成的初步草稿（anchor）进行双向上下文增强（包含上游调用场景和下游依赖信息），从而使模型能够更好地处理复杂的仓库级语义依赖。
AI.keywords: 仓库级代码生成, 双向内联, 大语言模型, 上下文增强, 代码依赖分析
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一种双向内联（bidirectional inlining）机制，将复杂的仓库级代码生成问题转化为更易于处理的函数级任务。通过生成锚点（anchor）来辅助上下文检索和构建，有效地克服了传统RAG方法在处理复杂依赖关系时的局限性。该方法对于提升大模型在大型代码库中的编程能力具有重要意义。

title: Dynamic Hyperparameter Importance for Efficient Multi-Objective Optimization
summary: Choosing a suitable ML model is a complex task that can depend on several objectives, e.g., accuracy, fairness, or energy consumption. In practice, this requires trading off multiple, often competing, objectives through multi-objective optimization (MOO). However, existing MOO methods typically treat all hyperparameters as equally important, disregarding that hyperparameter importance (HPI) can vary significantly across objectives. We propose a novel dynamic optimization approach that prioritizes the most influential hyperparameters based on varying objective trade-offs during the search, thereby accelerating empirical convergence. We advance prior work on HPI for MOO from post-analysis to direct, dynamic integration within the optimization, using the recent HPI method HyperSHAP. For this, we leverage the objective weightings naturally produced by the MOO algorithm ParEGO and reduce the configuration space by fixing the unimportant hyperparameters, allowing the search to focus on the important ones. Eventually, we evaluate our method on diverse tasks from PyMOO and YAHPO-Gym. For HPO, integrating HPI yields up to 24% improvement in final Pareto front quality, while on synthetic data, integrating HPI achieves 2x better final results.

title: Craig-Lyndon Interpolation for the Logic of Here and There with a Variation of Mints' Sequent System
summary: We present a variation of Maehara's method to construct Craig-Lyndon interpolants for the three-valued propositional logic of here and there (HT), also known as Gödel's $G_3$, a superintuitionistic logic of importance in logic programming. Our method adapts a recent interpolation technique that operates on classically encoded logic programs to a variation of Mints' sequent system for HT. The approach is characterized by two stages: First, a preliminary interpolant is constructed, a formula that is an interpolant in some sense but not yet the desired HT formula. In the second stage, an actual HT interpolant is obtained from this preliminary interpolant. With the classical encoding, the preliminary interpolant is a classical Craig-Lyndon interpolant for classical encodings of the two input HT formulas. In the presented adaptation, the sequent system operates directly on HT formulas, and the preliminary interpolant is in a nonclassical logic that generalizes HT by an additional logic operator.

AI.title_translation: “此处与那里”逻辑的Craig-Lyndon插值及其Mints序列演算变体
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种为逻辑编程中重要的HT逻辑构建Craig-Lyndon插值的新方法，通过两阶段法在Mints序列演算中实现了插值的构造。
AI.motivation: 旨在为重要的逻辑编程基础逻辑——“此处与那里”（HT）逻辑（即Gödel的G3逻辑）构建Craig-Lyndon插值，解决其在证明论层面的插值构造问题。
AI.method: 采用两阶段法：首先在扩展的非经典逻辑中构建初步插值，随后将其转化为HT逻辑的最终插值。该方法基于对Mints序列演算的直接操作，而非传统的古典逻辑编码。
AI.result: 成功构建了适用于HT逻辑的Craig-Lyndon插值算法，并证明了其在Mints序列演算系统下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 作者成功提出了一种基于Mints序列演算的HT逻辑Craig-Lyndon插值构建方法，为该逻辑的证明论研究提供了新的工具。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种Maehara方法的变体，用于为三值命题逻辑“此处与那里”（HT，也称为Gödel的G3，是逻辑编程中重要的超直觉逻辑）构建Craig-Lyndon插值。我们的方法改编了一种最近的插值技术，该技术作用于经典编码的逻辑程序，并将其应用于HT的Mints序列演算变体。该方法分为两个阶段：第一阶段，构建一个初步插值，它在某种意义上是插值，但还不是所需的HT公式。在第二阶段，从这个初步插值中获得实际的HT插值。在经典编码中，初步插值是两个输入HT公式的经典编码的经典Craig-Lyndon插值。在所提出的改编中，序列演算直接作用于HT公式，并且初步插值处于一种通过额外逻辑算子推广HT的非经典逻辑中。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种为“此处与那里”（HT）逻辑构建Craig-Lyndon插值的新方法。该方法通过对Mints序列演算的修改，利用两阶段过程：首先在扩展的非经典逻辑中生成初步插值，随后将其转化为HT逻辑公式，从而实现了对该逻辑插值的有效构造。
AI.keywords: 此处与那里逻辑, Craig-Lyndon插值, Mints序列演算, 逻辑编程, 证明论
AI.comments: 该论文通过对Mints序列演算系统的改造，成功为“此处与那里”（HT）逻辑构建了Craig-Lyndon插值。其创新点在于将经典的Maehara方法与现代的逻辑程序编码技术相结合，通过两阶段法处理非经典逻辑的插值问题。这对逻辑编程和知识表示领域具有重要的理论意义。

title: Inapproximability of Counting Permutation Patterns
summary:
Detecting and counting copies of permutation patterns are fundamental algorithmic problems, with applications in the analysis of rankings, nonparametric statistics, and property testing tasks such as independence and quasirandomness testing. From an algorithmic perspective, there is a sharp difference in complexity between detecting and counting the copies of a given length-$k$ pattern in a length-$n$ permutation. The former admits a $2^{\mathcal{O}(k^2)} \cdot n$ time algorithm (Guillemot and Marx, 2014) while the latter cannot be solved in time $f(k)\cdot n^{o(k/\log k)}$ unless the Exponential Time Hypothesis (ETH) fails (Berendsohn, Kozma, and Marx, 2021). In fact already for patterns of length 4, exact counting is unlikely to admit near-linear time algorithms under standard fine-grained complexity assumptions (Dudek and Gawrychowski, 2020).
  Recently, Ben-Eliezer, Mitrović and Sristava (2026) showed that for patterns of length up to 5, a $(1+\varepsilon)$-approximation of the pattern count can be computed in near-linear time, yielding a separation between exact and approximate counting for small patterns, and conjectured that approximate counting is asymptotically easier than exact counting in general. We strongly refute their conjecture by showing that, under ETH, no algorithm running in time $f(k)\cdot n^{o(k/\log k)}$ can approximate the number of copies of a length-$k$ pattern within a multiplicative factor $n^{(1/2-\varepsilon)k}$. The lower bound on runtime matches the conditional lower bound for exact pattern counting, and the obtained bound on the multiplicative error factor is essentially tight, as an $n^{k/2}$-approximation can be computed in $2^{\mathcal{O}(k^2)}\cdot n$ time using an algorithm for pattern detection.

title: Age of Gossip With Cellular Drone Mobility
summary: We consider a cellular network containing $n$ nodes where nodes within a cell gossip with each other in a fully-connected fashion and a source shares updates with these nodes via a mobile drone. The drone receives source updates and shares them with nodes in the cell where it currently resides. The drone moves between cells according to an underlying continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC). We evaluate the impact of the number of cells $f(n)$, drone speed $λ_m(n)$ and drone dissemination rate $λ_d(n)$ on the information freshness of nodes in the network. We use the version age of information metric to quantify information freshness. We observe that the expected duration between two drone-to-cell service times depends on the stationary distribution of the underlying CTMC and $λ_d(n)$, but not on $λ_m(n)$. However, the version age instability makes high probability analysis for a general underlying CTMC difficult. Therefore, we focus on the fully-connected drone mobility model. Under this model, we uncover a dual-bottleneck, by leveraging stochastic equivalence between drone mobility and drone dissemination speed: the version age is constrained by the slower of these two processes. If $λ_d(n) \gg λ_m(n)$, then the version age scaling of nodes is dominated by the inverse of $λ_m(n)$ and is independent of $λ_d(n)$. If $λ_m(n) \gg λ_d(n)$, then the version age scaling of nodes is dominated by the inverse of $λ_d(n)$ and is independent of $λ_m(n)$.

AI.title_translation: 基于蜂窝无人机移动性的八卦年龄（信息新鲜度）研究
AI.tldr: 本文分析了无人机辅助蜂窝网络中的信息新鲜度，发现无人机移动速度与数据分发速率构成双重瓶颈，系统性能受限于两者中的较慢者。
AI.motivation: 在无人机辅助的蜂窝网络中，研究无人机移动性、小区数量及分发速率如何影响节点获取信息的新鲜度，旨在寻找提升网络信息时效性的关键制约因素。
AI.method: 采用版本信息新鲜度（Version Age of Information）作为衡量指标，利用连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）对无人机在小区间的移动进行建模，并针对全连接移动模型分析了无人机移动速率与数据分发速率的随机等效性。
AI.result: 研究发现存在“双重瓶颈”现象：当分发速率远大于移动速率时，信息新鲜度受限于移动速率；反之，若移动速率远大于分发速率，则信息新鲜度受限于分发速率。无人机服务间隔的预期时长与分发速率及稳态分布有关，而与移动速率无关。
AI.conclusion: 在全连接无人机移动模型下，网络的信息新鲜度受限于无人机移动速度与数据分发速率中的较慢者。若要优化信息新鲜度，必须平衡这两个过程，避免单一瓶颈限制系统性能。
AI.translation: 我们考虑了一个包含 $n$ 个节点的蜂窝网络，其中小区内的节点以全连接方式共享信息，源节点通过移动无人机与这些节点共享更新。无人机接收源更新并将其分发给当前所在小区的节点。无人机根据连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）在小区之间移动。我们评估了小区数量 $f(n)$、无人机速度 $λ_m(n)$ 和无人机分发速率 $λ_d(n)$ 对网络中节点信息新鲜度的影响。我们使用版本信息新鲜度（Version Age of Information）指标来量化信息新鲜度。我们观察到，两次无人机到小区服务时间之间的预期持续时间取决于基础 CTMC 的平稳分布和 $λ_d(n)$，而不取决于 $λ_m(n)$。然而，版本年龄的不稳定性使得对一般基础 CTMC 的高概率分析变得困难。因此，我们重点研究了全连接无人机移动模型。在该模型下，通过利用无人机移动性和无人机分发速度之间的随机等效性，我们揭示了一个双重瓶颈：版本年龄受这两个过程中较慢者的约束。如果 $λ_d(n) \gg λ_m(n)$，则节点的版本年龄缩放由 $λ_m(n)$ 的倒数主导，且与 $λ_d(n)$ 无关。如果 $λ_m(n) \gg λ_d(n)$，则节点的版本年龄缩放由 $λ_d(n)$ 的倒数主导，且与 $λ_m(n)$ 无关。
AI.summary: 该文研究了由移动无人机辅助更新信息的蜂窝网络中的信息新鲜度问题。通过构建连续时间马尔可夫链模型，分析了小区数量、无人机移动速度和数据分发速率对版本信息新鲜度的影响，并揭示了无人机移动与数据分发之间的“双重瓶颈”制约关系。
AI.keywords: 信息新鲜度, 无人机移动性, 蜂窝网络, 马尔可夫链, 双重瓶颈
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入信息新鲜度（AoI）度量，深入探讨了蜂窝无人机网络中移动性和传播速率对信息更新的影响。其核心贡献在于揭示了“双重瓶颈”效应，即无人机移动速度与数据分发速率之间存在制约关系，这一发现为优化无人机辅助通信系统的设计提供了理论依据。局限在于该结论主要基于全连接移动模型，对于更复杂的拓扑结构适用性有待进一步验证。

title: PRISM: Color-Stratified Point Cloud Sampling
comments: This work has been submitted to the 2026 International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR) for possible publication
summary: We present PRISM, a novel color-guided stratified sampling method for RGB-LiDAR point clouds. Our approach is motivated by the observation that unique scene features often exhibit chromatic diversity while repetitive, redundant features are homogeneous in color. Conventional downsampling methods (Random Sampling, Voxel Grid, Normal Space Sampling) enforce spatial uniformity while ignoring this photometric content. In contrast, PRISM allocates sampling density proportional to chromatic diversity. By treating RGB color space as the stratification domain and imposing a maximum capacity k per color bin, the method preserves texture-rich regions with high color variation while substantially reducing visually homogeneous surfaces. This shifts the sampling space from spatial coverage to visual complexity to produce sparser point clouds that retain essential features for 3D reconstruction tasks.
comment: This work has been submitted to the 2026 International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR) for possible publication

AI.title_translation: PRISM：颜色分层点云采样
AI.tldr: PRISM利用色彩多样性指导点云下采样，优先保留视觉复杂区域，实现高效且特征保持的采样效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的传统下采样方法（如随机采样、体素网格等）仅关注空间均匀性，而忽略了RGB-LiDAR点云中重要的光度信息，导致无法有效区分关键特征和冗余数据。
AI.method: PRISM方法通过将RGB颜色空间作为分层域，根据色彩多样性分配采样密度，并对每个颜色箱（color bin）设置最大容量k，从而实现对纹理丰富区域的保留和对同质表面的精简。
AI.result: 实验表明，PRISM生成的稀疏点云在保留3D重建任务所需关键特征的同时，显著减少了视觉同质表面的数据量。
AI.conclusion: PRISM通过颜色分层采样策略，在减少点云数量的同时，有效地保留了视觉复杂区域的特征，证明了利用光度内容指导点云采样的有效性。
AI.translation: 我们提出了PRISM，一种用于RGB-LiDAR点云的新型颜色引导分层采样方法。我们的方法基于这样一个观察：独特的场景特征通常表现出色彩多样性，而重复、冗余的特征在颜色上是同质的。传统的下采样方法（随机采样、体素网格、法线空间采样）强制执行空间均匀性，却忽略了这些光度内容。相比之下，PRISM根据色彩多样性分配采样密度。通过将RGB颜色空间作为分层域，并对每个颜色箱施加最大容量k，该方法在保留高颜色变化纹理丰富区域的同时，大幅减少了视觉上同质的表面。这使得采样空间从空间覆盖转向视觉复杂性，从而产生能保留3D重建任务关键特征的稀疏点云。
AI.summary: PRISM是一种针对RGB-LiDAR点云的颜色引导分层采样方法。它通过分析色彩多样性来动态调整采样密度，优先保留颜色变化丰富的区域，从而在维持重建质量的前提下实现更高效的下采样。
AI.keywords: 点云采样, RGB-LiDAR, 颜色分层, 视觉复杂性, 3D重建
AI.comments: PRISM通过引入颜色信息作为采样依据，巧妙地将采样重点从几何空间转移到了视觉特征空间。其创新之处在于利用色彩多样性来指导采样密度，这对于保留纹理细节至关重要。局限性在于该方法高度依赖RGB数据的质量，若光照条件极差或颜色信息缺失，其性能可能会下降。

title: On the Non-decoupling of Supervised Fine-tuning and Reinforcement Learning in Post-training
summary: Post-training of large language models routinely interleaves supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with reinforcement learning (RL). These two methods have different objectives: SFT minimizes the cross-entropy loss between model outputs and expert responses, while RL maximizes reward signals derived from human preferences or rule-based verifiers. Modern reasoning models have widely adopted the practice of alternating SFT and RL training. However, there is no theoretical account of whether they can be decoupled. We prove that decoupling is impossible in either order: (1) SFT-then-RL coupling: RL increases SFT loss under both distributional (KL-based) and landscape (PL-based) analyses; and (2) RL-then-SFT coupling: SFT lowers the reward achieved by RL under analogous conditions. Under the PL condition, we further derive the optimal RL duration that balances reward improvement against SFT degradation, identify the non-decoupling threshold governing when RL can improve SFT, and bound the gradient misalignment via spectral concentration. Experiments on Qwen3-0.6B confirm the predicted degradation, verifying that SFT and RL cannot be separated without loss of prior performance in the post-training pipeline.

AI.title_translation: 论后训练中监督微调与强化学习的不可解耦性
AI.tldr: 研究证明大型语言模型的监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）在后训练中存在本质的耦合关系，无法在不牺牲性能的情况下将其独立拆分。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练流程广泛采用SFT与RL交替训练，但缺乏理论支持来解释为何两者不能解耦，作者旨在探究这种耦合机制及其对模型性能的影响。
AI.method: 通过分布（基于KL散度）和景观（基于PL条件）分析，证明了SFT与RL的不可解耦性；推导了平衡奖励提升与SFT性能退化的最优RL时长，并利用谱集中不等式界定了梯度失调。
AI.result: 证明了SFT后接RL会导致SFT损失增加，而RL后接SFT会降低RL获得的奖励；在Qwen3-0.6B上的实验验证了上述理论预测的性能退化。
AI.conclusion: SFT与RL在后训练中无法解耦，两者之间存在固有的权衡与性能退化风险，必须在训练策略中进行协同优化。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型的后训练通常会将监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）交替进行。这两种方法的目标不同：SFT旨在最小化模型输出与专家响应之间的交叉熵损失，而RL则旨在最大化源自人类偏好或基于规则的验证器的奖励信号。现代推理模型已广泛采用SFT与RL交替训练的做法。然而，目前尚无理论解释它们是否可以解耦。我们证明了无论采用何种顺序，解耦都是不可能的：（1）SFT后接RL：在分布（基于KL）和景观（基于PL）分析下，RL都会增加SFT损失；（2）RL后接SFT：在类似条件下，SFT会降低RL获得的奖励。在PL条件下，我们进一步推导了平衡奖励提升与SFT退化的最优RL时长，确定了RL何时能改善SFT的非解耦阈值，并通过谱集中界定了梯度失调。在Qwen3-0.6B上的实验证实了预期的退化，验证了在后训练流程中，如果不损失先前的性能，SFT和RL是无法分离的。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了大型语言模型后训练中SFT与RL的相互依赖性。研究证明了两者无法解耦，即无论采用何种顺序，一种训练方法都会对另一种的效果产生负面影响，并推导了权衡这些影响的理论阈值。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 监督微调, 强化学习, 后训练, 模型解耦
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了大型语言模型后训练中监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）之间深刻的内在耦合关系，挑战了将两者视为独立优化阶段的常见假设。其理论分析与实验验证相结合，为理解模型训练动态提供了重要视角。

title: TMATDG: applying TDG methods to multiple scattering via T-matrix approximation
summary: We present a MATLAB package for the solution of multiple scattering problems, coupling Trefftz Discontinuos Galerkin methods for Helmholtz scattering with the T-matrix method. We rely on the TMATROM package to numerically approximate the T-matrices and deal with multiple scattering problem, providing a framework to handle scattering by polygonal obstacles.

AI.title_translation: TMATDG：通过T矩阵近似将TDG方法应用于多重散射问题
AI.tldr: 开发了一个结合TDG和T矩阵方法的MATLAB工具包，用于求解多边形障碍物的多重散射问题。
AI.motivation: 为了解决复杂的多重散射问题，特别是针对多边形障碍物，需要一个能够耦合TDG方法和T矩阵方法的计算工具。
AI.method: 使用基于Trefftz间断Galerkin（TDG）的方法求解Helmholtz散射，并与T矩阵方法耦合，利用TMATROM包进行数值近似，专门处理多边形障碍物。
AI.result: 开发了一个用于求解多重散射问题的MATLAB软件包（TMATDG），能够处理多边形障碍物的散射情况。
AI.conclusion: TMATDG是一个有效的MATLAB软件包，能够通过结合TDG和T矩阵方法，高效地求解多边形障碍物的多重散射问题。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一个用于求解多重散射问题的MATLAB软件包，将用于Helmholtz散射的Trefftz间断Galerkin（TDG）方法与T矩阵方法相结合。我们依赖TMATROM软件包来数值近似T矩阵并处理多重散射问题，提供了一个处理多边形障碍物散射的框架。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一个名为TMATDG的MATLAB软件包，该软件包通过将Trefftz间断Galerkin（TDG）方法与T矩阵方法相结合，提供了一种求解多边形障碍物多重散射问题的新框架。
AI.keywords: 多重散射, Trefftz间断Galerkin方法, T矩阵方法, Helmholtz方程, 数值模拟
AI.comments: 该工作通过将Trefftz间断Galerkin（TDG）方法与T矩阵方法相结合，为处理多边形障碍物的多重散射问题提供了一个实用的计算框架。其创新点在于结合了两种成熟的数值技术，提高了处理复杂几何形状散射问题的能力。限制在于目前仅针对Helmholtz散射，且依赖于特定的TMATROM包。

title: SafeRedir: Prompt Embedding Redirection for Robust Unlearning in Image Generation Models
summary: Image generation models (IGMs), while capable of producing impressive and creative content, often memorize a wide range of undesirable concepts from their training data, leading to the reproduction of unsafe content such as NSFW imagery and copyrighted artistic styles. Such behaviors pose persistent safety and compliance risks in real-world deployments and cannot be reliably mitigated by post-hoc filtering, owing to the limited robustness of such mechanisms and a lack of fine-grained semantic control. Recent unlearning methods seek to erase harmful concepts at the model level, which exhibit the limitations of requiring costly retraining, degrading the quality of benign generations, or failing to withstand prompt paraphrasing and adversarial attacks. To address these challenges, we introduce SafeRedir, a lightweight inference-time framework for robust unlearning via prompt embedding redirection. Without modifying the underlying IGMs, SafeRedir adaptively routes unsafe prompts toward safe semantic regions through token-level interventions in the embedding space. The framework comprises two core components: a latent-aware multi-modal safety classifier for identifying unsafe generation trajectories, and a token-level delta generator for precise semantic redirection, equipped with auxiliary predictors for token masking and adaptive scaling to localize and regulate the intervention. Empirical results across multiple representative unlearning tasks demonstrate that SafeRedir achieves effective unlearning capability, high semantic and perceptual preservation, robust image quality, and enhanced resistance to adversarial attacks. Furthermore, SafeRedir generalizes effectively across a variety of diffusion backbones and existing unlearned models, validating its plug-and-play compatibility and broad applicability. Code and data are available at https://github.com/ryliu68/SafeRedir.

AI.title_translation: SafeRedir：用于图像生成模型稳健遗忘的提示词嵌入重定向技术
AI.tldr: SafeRedir 是一种无需修改模型权重、推理时运行的轻量级安全防御框架，通过将有害提示词重定向至安全语义空间，实现了图像生成模型中不安全内容的有效遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有图像生成模型常记忆有害概念（如 NSFW、版权内容），而现有的过滤机制鲁棒性不足，模型层面的遗忘方法又存在训练成本高、损害模型性能、难以抵抗对抗性攻击等问题。
AI.method: SafeRedir 框架。包含两个核心组件：1. 潜在感知多模态安全分类器，用于识别不安全的生成路径；2. 令牌级增量生成器，通过令牌掩码和自适应缩放机制，将不安全提示词嵌入重定向至安全语义区域。
AI.result: SafeRedir 在多项遗忘任务中表现优异，在有效消除有害内容的同时，保持了良好的语义理解、图像质量，并显著提升了对抗攻击的抵抗力，且具备良好的模型通用性。
AI.conclusion: SafeRedir 提供了一种轻量级、高效且鲁棒的图像生成模型安全防御方案，通过在推理阶段对提示词嵌入进行精确重定向，实现了在不损坏模型生成能力前提下的有害概念移除。
AI.translation: 图像生成模型 (IGMs) 在生成令人印象深刻的创意内容的同时，往往会记忆训练数据中广泛的不良概念，从而导致 NSFW 图像和受版权保护的艺术风格等不安全内容的再现。这种行为在实际部署中构成了持续的安全和合规风险，由于此类机制的鲁棒性有限且缺乏细粒度的语义控制，仅靠事后过滤无法可靠地缓解这些问题。最近的遗忘方法试图在模型层面擦除有害概念，但这些方法存在需要昂贵的再训练、降低良性生成质量或无法抵御提示词释义和对抗性攻击等局限性。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了 SafeRedir，这是一个通过提示词嵌入重定向进行鲁棒遗忘的轻量级推理时框架。SafeRedir 无需修改底层 IGM，通过嵌入空间中的令牌级干预，自适应地将不安全提示词路由到安全语义区域。该框架包含两个核心组件：用于识别不安全生成轨迹的潜在感知多模态安全分类器，以及用于精确语义重定向的令牌级增量生成器，并配备了用于令牌掩码和自适应缩放的辅助预测器，以定位和调节干预。在多个代表性遗忘任务上的实证结果表明，SafeRedir 实现了有效的遗忘能力、高语义和感知保持、稳健的图像质量以及增强的对抗攻击抵抗力。此外，SafeRedir 在各种扩散骨干网和现有的已遗忘模型中均能有效泛化，验证了其即插即用的兼容性和广泛的适用性。代码和数据可在 https://github.com/ryliu68/SafeRedir 获取。
AI.summary: SafeRedir 是一种用于图像生成模型的推理时安全遗忘框架，它通过在嵌入空间对不安全提示词进行令牌级重定向，在不修改模型参数的前提下，实现了对有害内容的鲁棒性过滤，并保持了模型原本的生成质量。
AI.keywords: 图像生成模型, 模型遗忘, 提示词嵌入重定向, 安全防御, 推理时优化
AI.comments: SafeRedir 创新性地提出了一种推理时（inference-time）的重定向方法，无需修改模型权重，有效解决了传统遗忘方法（unlearning）带来的模型退化和高昂训练成本问题。其插件式的设计使其具有极强的通用性，是当前图像生成模型安全防御领域的一个重要进展。

title: ProFit: Leveraging High-Value Signals in SFT via Probability-Guided Token Selection
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is a fundamental post-training strategy to align Large Language Models (LLMs) with human intent. However, traditional SFT often ignores the one-to-many nature of language by forcing alignment with a single reference answer, leading to the model overfitting to non-core expressions. Although our empirical analysis suggests that introducing multiple reference answers can mitigate this issue, the prohibitive data and computational costs necessitate a strategic shift: prioritizing the mitigation of single-reference overfitting over the costly pursuit of answer diversity. To achieve this, we reveal the intrinsic connection between token probability and semantic importance: high-probability tokens carry the core logical framework, while low-probability tokens are mostly replaceable expressions. Based on this insight, we propose ProFit, which selectively masks low-probability tokens to prevent surface-level overfitting. Extensive experiments confirm that ProFit consistently outperforms traditional SFT baselines on general reasoning and mathematical benchmarks.

AI.title_translation: ProFit：通过概率引导的标记选择利用SFT中的高价值信号
AI.tldr: ProFit通过在SFT训练中掩盖低概率的非核心标记，防止模型过度拟合单一参考答案，从而提升了模型在推理任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 传统监督微调（SFT）强制模型拟合单一参考答案，导致模型过度拟合非核心的表面表达，而增加参考答案多样性的成本过高。
AI.method: 提出ProFit方法，通过分析标记概率与语义重要性的关系，在训练过程中选择性地掩盖低概率（非核心）标记，仅对高概率（核心逻辑）标记进行监督学习。
AI.result: 实验表明，ProFit在通用推理和数学基准测试中均优于传统的SFT基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ProFit通过选择性掩盖低概率标记，有效缓解了SFT中的表面特征过拟合问题，在推理和数学任务中表现优异。
AI.translation: 监督微调（SFT）是将大语言模型（LLM）与人类意图对齐的基本后训练策略。然而，传统的SFT往往忽视语言的一对多特性，强制模型与单一参考答案对齐，导致模型对非核心表达产生过拟合。尽管我们的实证分析表明引入多个参考答案可以缓解这一问题，但高昂的数据和计算成本要求我们进行战略性转变：优先解决单一参考答案的过拟合问题，而非盲目追求答案多样性。为了实现这一目标，我们揭示了标记概率与语义重要性之间的内在联系：高概率标记承载了核心逻辑框架，而低概率标记大多是可替换的表达。基于这一见解，我们提出了ProFit，通过选择性掩盖低概率标记来防止表面级的过拟合。大量实验证实，ProFit在通用推理和数学基准测试中始终优于传统的SFT基线。
AI.summary: 为了解决SFT中因强制拟合单一参考答案导致的表面特征过拟合问题，本文提出了ProFit方法。该方法基于标记概率与语义重要性之间的内在联系，通过在训练中选择性掩盖低概率标记，强迫模型聚焦于核心逻辑框架，从而提升了模型在推理任务中的表现。
AI.keywords: 监督微调, 概率引导, 过拟合, 大语言模型, 标记选择
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地利用模型自身的概率分布作为一种“高价值信号”来指导SFT训练，巧妙地解决了传统SFT过度拟合单参考答案的问题，无需额外数据，具有很高的实用价值和计算效率。

title: Improving the local solution of the DG predictor of the ADER-DG method for solving systems of ordinary differential equations and its applicability to systems of differential-algebraic equations
summary: Improved local numerical solution for the ADER-DG numerical method with a local DG predictor for solving the initial value problem for a first-order ODE system is proposed. The improved local numerical solution demonstrates convergence orders of one higher than the convergence order of the local numerical solution of the original ADER-DG numerical method and has the property of continuity at grid nodes. Rigorous proofs of the approximation orders of the local numerical solution and the improved local numerical solution are presented. Obtaining the proposed improved local numerical solution does not require significant changes to the structure of the ADER-DG numerical method. Therefore, all conclusions regarding the convergence orders of the numerical solution at grid nodes, the resulting superconvergence, and the high stability of the ADER-DG numerical method remain unchanged. A wide range of applications of the ADER-DG numerical method is presented for solving specific initial value problems for ODE systems for a wide range of polynomial degrees. The obtained results provide strong confirmation for the developed rigorous theory. The improved local numerical solution is shown to exhibit both higher accuracy and improved smoothness and point-wise comparability. Empirical convergence orders of all individual numerical solutions were calculated for a wide range of error norms, which well agree with the expected convergence orders. The rigorous proof, based on the $ε$-embedding method, of the applicability of the ADER-DG numerical method with a local DG predictor to solving DAE systems is presents.

AI.title_translation: 改进ADER-DG方法中DG预测器的局部解以求解常微分方程组及其在微分代数方程组中的适用性
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种改进的ADER-DG局部预测器，在保持原算法架构的同时提升了计算精度与收敛阶，并证明了其对微分代数方程（DAE）的适用性。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决传统ADER-DG方法在求解一阶常微分方程初值问题时局部数值解精度与连续性不足的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种改进的局部数值解方法，通过优化局部DG预测器，在保持原有ADER-DG方法架构不变的情况下，实现了更高阶的收敛性，并使用ε-嵌入法证明了其在DAE系统中的适用性。
AI.result: 改进后的局部数值解在网格节点上表现出比原方法高一阶的收敛性，具有更好的光滑度，且经理论证明该方法同样适用于微分代数方程（DAE）系统，数值实验验证了理论预期。
AI.conclusion: 改进后的局部数值解在保持原ADER-DG方法稳定性和原有收敛特性的基础上，提升了计算精度和光滑度，并被证明适用于微分代数方程（DAE）系统。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种改进的ADER-DG数值方法局部数值解，用于求解一阶常微分方程组的初值问题。该改进解法在网格节点上表现出的收敛阶比原始ADER-DG方法高出一阶，并具备连续性。文中给出了局部数值解和改进局部数值解近似阶的严格证明。获得该改进解法无需对ADER-DG方法结构进行重大修改，因此关于网格节点收敛阶、超收敛性及高稳定性的结论保持不变。本文展示了该方法在多种多项式次数下求解常微分方程初值问题的广泛应用，数值结果有力支持了严谨的理论。改进后的局部数值解表现出更高的精度、更好的光滑度及逐点可比性。计算得出的各项数值解收敛阶与预期高度一致。此外，本文利用ε-嵌入法严格证明了带有局部DG预测器的ADER-DG方法在求解DAE系统中的适用性。
AI.summary: 本文针对ADER-DG数值方法提出了一种改进的局部数值解方案。该方案在不改动原算法结构的前提下，提升了局部解的收敛阶和连续性，并通过理论证明与数值实验验证了其精度与稳定性，同时论证了该方法在求解微分代数方程系统中的有效性。
AI.keywords: ADER-DG方法, 常微分方程, 局部预测器, 收敛阶, 微分代数方程
AI.comments: 该论文通过对ADER-DG方法的局部预测器进行改进，在不破坏原有算法架构的前提下，实现了更高的收敛阶和更好的连续性，具有极高的实用价值。其利用ε-嵌入法对DAE系统的适用性证明也是该研究的重要理论贡献。

title: torch-sla: Differentiable Sparse Linear Algebra with Adjoint Solvers and Sparse Tensor Parallelism for PyTorch
summary: Differentiable sparse linear algebra is foundational for scientific machine learning, yet PyTorch lacks a unified library for it: \texttt{torch.sparse} provides only low-level kernels and a non-differentiable, CPU-only \texttt{spsolve}, and \texttt{torch.linalg} is dense-only. We present \torchsla{}, an open-source library that fills this gap. It exposes a single autograd-aware API for direct, iterative, nonlinear, and eigenvalue solvers across five interchangeable backends -- SciPy and Eigen on CPU, cuDSS, CuPy, and a PyTorch-native iterative solver on GPU -- with automatic dispatch by device and problem size. The library further supports batched solves over shared or distinct sparsity patterns and distributed multi-GPU execution via domain decomposition with halo exchange. These capabilities are made scalable by an O(1)-graph adjoint differentiation framework and an autograd-compatible distributed halo-exchange layer. The library is available at https://www.torchsla.com/.

AI.title_translation: torch-sla：PyTorch中结合伴随求解器与稀疏张量并行的可微分稀疏线性代数库
AI.tldr: torch-sla是一个填补PyTorch稀疏线性代数空白的开源库，通过统一API、多后端支持和分布式并行技术，实现了高效的可微分稀疏求解。
AI.motivation: PyTorch现有的torch.sparse库功能有限（仅支持CPU且不可导），而torch.linalg仅支持稠密矩阵，无法满足科学机器学习对高效、可微分稀疏线性代数的需求。
AI.method: 开发了一个统一的autograd感知API，支持五个可互换的后端（SciPy, Eigen, cuDSS, CuPy, PyTorch原生迭代求解器）；实现了O(1)图伴随微分框架以处理梯度计算；并引入了基于域分解和光环交换（halo exchange）的分布式多GPU并行机制。
AI.result: 实现了跨设备和问题规模的自动调度，支持批量求解共享或不同稀疏模式，并在多GPU环境下实现了可扩展的分布式执行。
AI.conclusion: torch-sla为PyTorch提供了一个高效、可微分且支持分布式计算的稀疏线性代数库，极大地促进了科学机器学习在深度学习框架中的应用。
AI.translation: 可微分稀疏线性代数是科学机器学习的基础，但PyTorch缺乏一个统一的库来实现它：torch.sparse仅提供低级内核和一个非可导、仅限CPU的spsolve，而torch.linalg仅支持稠密运算。我们提出了torch-sla，一个填补这一空白的开源库。它暴露了一个单一的、具备自动求导能力的API，用于跨五个可互换后端（CPU上的SciPy和Eigen，GPU上的cuDSS、CuPy以及PyTorch原生迭代求解器）的直接、迭代、非线性及特征值求解器，并根据设备和问题规模进行自动调度。该库进一步支持跨共享或不同稀疏模式的批量求解，以及通过带有光环交换的域分解进行分布式多GPU执行。这些功能通过O(1)图伴随微分框架和与自动求导兼容的分布式光环交换层实现可扩展性。库地址：https://www.torchsla.com/。
AI.summary: torch-sla是一个专为PyTorch设计的开源库，旨在提供统一、可微分的稀疏线性代数求解器。它支持多种CPU/GPU后端，具备自动求导功能，并通过O(1)伴随微分框架和分布式光环交换技术，实现了在大规模科学计算中的高效扩展。
AI.keywords: 可微分稀疏线性代数, PyTorch, 伴随求解器, 稀疏张量并行, 科学机器学习
AI.comments: 该论文填补了PyTorch在可微分稀疏线性代数领域的空白，通过统一的API整合了多种后端，并特别针对科学机器学习场景优化了性能和可扩展性，尤其是其O(1)图伴随微分框架具有很高的研究价值。

title: Progressive $\mathcal{J}$-Invariant Self-supervised Learning for Low-Dose CT Denoising
summary: Self-supervised learning has been increasingly investigated for low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) image denoising, as it alleviates the dependence on paired normal-dose CT (NDCT) data, which are often difficult to collect. However, many existing self-supervised blind-spot denoising methods suffer from training inefficiencies and suboptimal performance due to restricted receptive fields. To mitigate this issue, we propose a novel Progressive $\mathcal{J}$-invariant Learning that maximizes the use of $\mathcal{J}$-invariant to enhance LDCT denoising performance. We introduce a step-wise blind-spot denoising mechanism that enforces conditional independence in a progressive manner, enabling more fine-grained learning for denoising. Furthermore, we explicitly inject a combination of controlled Gaussian and Poisson noise during training to regularize the denoising process and mitigate overfitting. Extensive experiments on the Mayo LDCT dataset demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms existing self-supervised approaches and achieves performance comparable to, or better than, several representative supervised denoising methods.

AI.title_translation: 用于低剂量CT去噪的渐进式J不变自监督学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型渐进式J不变自监督学习方法，通过改进盲点去噪机制和噪声正则化，在无需配对数据的情况下实现了优于现有自监督及部分有监督方法的CT去噪效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的自监督盲点去噪方法由于感受野受限，存在训练效率低下和去噪性能不佳的问题，且难以获取成对的正常剂量CT数据。
AI.method: 提出了一种渐进式J不变学习（Progressive J-invariant Learning）方法，采用阶梯式盲点去噪机制以实现渐进式的条件独立，并在训练中显式注入高斯和泊松噪声以进行正则化。
AI.result: 在Mayo LDCT数据集上的实验表明，该方法在去噪性能上优于现有的自监督方法，并达到了与代表性有监督去噪方法相当甚至更好的效果。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的渐进式J不变学习方法能够有效提升LDCT去噪性能，证明了在无需成对数据的情况下，通过优化自监督学习范式可以达到甚至超越有监督学习的效果。
AI.translation: 自监督学习因其减少了对难以收集的成对正常剂量CT（NDCT）数据的依赖，在低剂量CT（LDCT）图像去噪方面受到了越来越多的关注。然而，许多现有的自监督盲点去噪方法由于感受野受限，存在训练效率低和性能欠佳的问题。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的渐进式J不变学习方法，通过最大化利用J不变性来增强LDCT去噪性能。我们引入了一种阶梯式盲点去噪机制，以渐进的方式强制执行条件独立，从而实现更精细的去噪学习。此外，我们在训练过程中显式注入了受控的高斯和泊松噪声组合，以规范去噪过程并减轻过拟合。在Mayo LDCT数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在性能上始终优于现有的自监督方法，并达到了与几种代表性有监督去噪方法相当或更好的性能。
AI.summary: 针对低剂量CT去噪中自监督学习面临的问题，本文提出了一种渐进式J不变学习框架，通过优化盲点去噪机制和噪声正则化策略，有效提升了图像去噪的质量和训练效率。
AI.keywords: 低剂量CT, 自监督学习, J-不变性, 图像去噪, 盲点去噪
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入“渐进式J不变性”解决了盲点去噪方法中感受野受限和训练效率低的问题，提出了一种创新的训练范式，在无需配对数据的情况下取得了与有监督学习相当的性能，具有很高的实用价值。

title: A Universal Large Language Model -- Drone Command and Control Interface
summary: The use of artificial intelligence (AI) for drone control can have a transformative impact on drone capabilities, especially when real world information can be integrated with drone sensing, command, and control, part of a growing field of physical AI. Large language models (LLMs) can be advantageous if trained at scale on general knowledge, but especially and in particular when the training data includes information such as detailed map geography topology of the entire planet, as well as the ability to access real time situational data such as weather. However, challenges remain in the interface between drones and LLMs in general, with each application requiring a tedious, labor intensive effort to connect the LLM trained knowledge to drone command and control. Here, we solve that problem, using an interface strategy that is LLM agnostic and drone agnostic, providing the first universal, versatile, comprehensive and easy to use drone control interface. We do this using the new model context protocol (MCP) standard, an open standard that provides a universal way for AI systems to access external data, tools, and services. We develop and deploy a cloud based Linux machine hosting an MCP server that supports the Mavlink protocol, an ubiquitous drone control language used almost universally by millions of drones including Ardupilot and PX4 framework.We demonstrate flight control of a real unmanned aerial vehicle. In further testing, we demonstrate extensive flight planning and control capability in a simulated drone, integrated with a Google Maps MCP server for up to date, real time navigation information. This demonstrates a universal approach to integration of LLMs with drone command and control, a paradigm that leverages and exploits virtually all of modern AI industry with drone technology in an easy to use interface that translates natural language to drone control.

title: DSVM-UNet : Enhancing VM-UNet with Dual Self-distillation for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Vision Mamba models have been extensively researched in various fields, which address the limitations of previous models by effectively managing long-range dependencies with a linear-time overhead. Several prospective studies have further designed Vision Mamba based on UNet(VM-UNet) for medical image segmentation. These approaches primarily focus on optimizing architectural designs by creating more complex structures to enhance the model's ability to perceive semantic features. In this paper, we propose a simple yet effective approach to improve the model by Dual Self-distillation for VM-UNet (DSVM-UNet) without any complex architectural designs. To achieve this goal, we develop double self-distillation methods to align the features at both the global and local levels. Extensive experiments conducted on the ISIC2017, ISIC2018, and Synapse benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance while maintaining computational efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/RoryShao/DSVM-UNet.git.

title: A Scalable Multi-Task Model for Virtual Sensors
summary: Virtual sensors replace expensive physical sensors in critical applications through machine learning by predicting target signals from available measurements. Existing virtual sensor approaches require application-specific models with hand-selected inputs for each sensor, cannot leverage task synergies, and lack consistent benchmarks. While emerging time series foundation models offer general-purpose, pretrained solutions in other domains, they are computationally expensive and limited to predicting their input signals, making them incompatible with virtual sensors. We introduce the first multi-task model for virtual sensors addressing both limitations. Our unified model can simultaneously predict diverse virtual sensors exploiting synergies while maintaining computational efficiency. It learns relevant input signals for each virtual sensor, eliminating expert knowledge requirements while adding explainability. In our large-scale evaluation on three standard benchmarks and an application-specific dataset with over 18 billion samples, our architecture reduces computation time by up to 415x and memory requirements by 951x, while maintaining or even improving predictive quality compared to unified baselines. Compared to existing isolated models for a single virtual sensor, our unified approach generates superior predictions at similar inference speed while scaling gracefully to hundreds of virtual sensors with nearly constant parameter count, enabling practical deployment in large-scale sensor networks.

AI.title_translation: 一种可扩展的虚拟传感器多任务模型
AI.tldr: 这是一种新型虚拟传感器多任务模型，通过统一架构替代孤立模型，实现了计算效率的显著提升（最高415倍）和存储成本的极度压缩，同时无需专家知识即可实现高性能预测。
AI.motivation: 现有虚拟传感器方法依赖特定应用且需手动选择输入，缺乏任务协同；而现有的时间序列基础模型计算成本过高且无法预测非输入信号，因此需要一种既高效又能处理多任务的通用模型。
AI.method: 提出了一种统一的多任务模型，能够同时预测多种虚拟传感器信号，利用任务间的协同效应，并自动学习相关输入信号以消除对专家知识的依赖。
AI.result: 在包含超过180亿样本的大规模评估中，该模型计算时间减少了415倍，内存需求减少了951倍，同时在预测质量上优于或等同于现有基准，并能随着传感器数量的增加保持参数量近乎恒定。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功构建了一个高效、可扩展的多任务虚拟传感器模型，在保持高预测质量的同时，实现了计算效率和存储需求的数量级优化，为大规模工业部署提供了有力支持。
AI.translation: 虚拟传感器通过机器学习利用现有测量值预测目标信号，从而在关键应用中替代昂贵的物理传感器。现有的虚拟传感器方法需要针对每个传感器使用特定应用模型，并手动选择输入，无法利用任务间的协同效应，且缺乏统一的基准。虽然新兴的时间序列基础模型在其他领域提供了通用的预训练方案，但它们计算成本高昂，且仅限于预测其输入信号，无法满足虚拟传感器的需求。我们引入了第一个解决上述局限性的虚拟传感器多任务模型。我们的统一模型可以在利用协同效应的同时，同时预测多种虚拟传感器信号，并保持计算效率。它能为每个虚拟传感器学习相关的输入信号，消除了对专家知识的需求，并增加了可解释性。在对三个标准基准和一个包含超过180亿样本的特定应用数据集进行的大规模评估中，我们的架构在保持甚至提高预测质量的同时，将计算时间减少了415倍，内存需求减少了951倍。与现有的单个虚拟传感器孤立模型相比，我们的统一方法在相似的推理速度下生成了更优的预测，并能优雅地扩展到数百个虚拟传感器，且参数数量几乎保持不变，从而实现了在大规模传感器网络中的实际部署。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于虚拟传感器的首个多任务模型，旨在解决现有方法在计算效率、模型通用性和专家知识依赖方面的局限性。该模型通过统一架构同时预测多种传感器信号，显著提升了资源利用率，并在大规模数据集上验证了其在性能和可扩展性方面的优势。
AI.keywords: 虚拟传感器, 多任务学习, 时间序列, 计算效率, 可解释性
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于解决了虚拟传感器领域中模型孤立、依赖专家知识以及计算效率低下的问题。通过引入多任务学习框架，不仅实现了跨任务的协同效应，还大幅降低了资源消耗，展现了在工业大规模传感器网络中的极高应用价值。

title: Visual Disentangled Diffusion Autoencoders: Scalable Counterfactual Generation for Foundation Models
summary: Foundation models, despite their robust zero-shot capabilities, remain vulnerable to spurious correlations and 'Clever Hans' strategies. Existing mitigation methods often rely on unavailable group labels or computationally expensive gradient-based adversarial optimization. To address these limitations, we propose Visual Disentangled Diffusion Autoencoders (DiDAE), a novel framework integrating frozen foundation models with disentangled dictionary learning for efficient, gradient-free counterfactual generation directly for the foundation model. DiDAE first edits foundation model embeddings in interpretable disentangled directions of the disentangled dictionary and then decodes them via a diffusion autoencoder. This allows the generation of multiple diverse, disentangled counterfactuals for each factual, much faster than existing baselines, which generate single entangled counterfactuals. When paired with Counterfactual Knowledge Distillation, DiDAE-CFKD achieves state-of-the-art performance in mitigating shortcut learning, improving downstream performance on unbalanced datasets.

title: Defining Operational Conditions for Safety-Critical AI-Based Systems from Data
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has been on the rise in many domains, including numerous safety-critical applications. However, for complex systems in the real world, defining the underlying environmental conditions in which the AI-based system must operate -- the Operational Design Domain (ODD) -- is extremely challenging. This often results in an incomplete description of the ODD, which contrasts with the requirements of many domains for certifying AI-based systems. Traditionally, the ODD is created in the early stages of the development process, drawing on sophisticated expert knowledge and related standards. This paper presents a novel Safety-by-Design method to a posteriori define the ODD from previously collected data using a multi-dimensional kernel-based representation. This approach is validated through both Monte Carlo methods and a real-world aviation use case for a future collision-avoidance system. Moreover, by defining under what conditions two ODDs are similar, the paper shows that the data-driven ODD can produce a dataset similar to the original, hidden ODD. Deriving the novel, Safety-by-Design, deterministic kernel-based affinity representation of ODDs is fully automated via a bounded, order-independent algorithm. Utilizing the proposed ODD representation enables future certification of data-driven, safety-critical AI-based systems.

AI.title_translation: 基于数据的安全关键AI系统操作条件定义方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种从数据中自动推导AI系统操作设计域（ODD）的核表示方法，以解决安全关键系统认证中ODD定义不完整的问题。
AI.motivation: 复杂系统在现实世界中难以准确定义操作设计域（ODD），导致ODD描述不完整，难以满足安全关键系统认证的严格要求。传统的基于专家知识的方法在早期开发阶段存在局限性。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于多维核表示的“安全设计（Safety-by-Design）”方法，通过有界且与顺序无关的算法，从历史数据中自动推导出ODD，并利用蒙特卡洛方法和航空碰撞避免系统的实际用例进行验证。
AI.result: 通过实验验证，该方法不仅能够成功推导出ODD，还证明了数据驱动的ODD能够生成与原始隐藏ODD相似的数据集，为AI系统的未来认证提供了一种可行的技术途径。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一种自动化的、数据驱动的ODD定义方法，能够通过多维核表示有效描述安全关键系统的操作条件，为AI系统的认证提供了坚实的技术基础。
AI.translation: 人工智能（AI）在许多领域（包括众多安全关键应用）中日益普及。然而，对于现实世界中的复杂系统，定义AI系统必须在其下运行的基础环境条件（即操作设计域，ODD）极具挑战性。这往往导致ODD的描述不完整，与许多领域对AI系统认证的要求相冲突。传统上，ODD是在开发过程的早期阶段，利用复杂的专家知识和相关标准创建的。本文提出了一种创新的“安全设计”方法，利用多维核表示法从先前收集的数据中后验定义ODD。该方法通过蒙特卡洛方法和未来碰撞避免系统的真实航空用例进行了验证。此外，通过定义两个ODD在何种条件下相似，本文表明数据驱动的ODD可以产生类似于原始隐藏ODD的数据集。通过有界、与顺序无关的算法，推导出创新的、安全设计的、确定性核亲和力ODD表示过程已实现完全自动化。利用所提出的ODD表示法，可以实现数据驱动的安全关键AI系统的未来认证。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种从历史数据中自动定义安全关键系统操作设计域（ODD）的新方法。该方法采用多维核表示，通过自动化的算法实现ODD的后验定义，并通过航空用例验证了其有效性，从而支持复杂AI系统的安全认证。
AI.keywords: 操作设计域 (ODD), 安全关键系统, 人工智能认证, 多维核表示, 数据驱动方法
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的数据驱动方法来定义AI系统的操作设计域（ODD），将传统的基于专家经验的静态定义转变为基于数据的动态定义。其核心贡献在于引入多维核表示法，解决了复杂系统中ODD定义不完整的问题，对于AI系统的安全认证具有重要的实际意义。

title: OpenVTON-Bench: A Large-Scale High-Resolution Benchmark for Controllable Virtual Try-On Evaluation
summary: Recent advances in diffusion models have significantly elevated the visual fidelity of Virtual Try-On (VTON) systems, yet reliable evaluation remains a persistent bottleneck. Traditional metrics struggle to quantify fine-grained texture details and semantic consistency, while existing datasets fail to meet commercial standards in scale and diversity. We present OpenVTON-Bench, a large-scale benchmark comprising approximately 100K high-resolution image pairs (up to $1536 \times 1536$). The dataset is constructed using DINOv3-based hierarchical clustering for semantically balanced sampling and Gemini-powered dense captioning, ensuring a uniform distribution across 20 fine-grained garment categories. To support reliable evaluation, we propose a multi-modal protocol that measures VTON quality along five interpretable dimensions: background consistency, identity fidelity, texture fidelity, shape plausibility, and overall realism. The protocol integrates VLM-based semantic reasoning with a novel Multi-Scale Representation Metric based on SAM3 segmentation and morphological erosion, enabling the separation of boundary alignment errors from internal texture artifacts. Experimental results show strong agreement with human judgments (Kendall's $τ$ of 0.833 vs. 0.611 for SSIM), establishing a robust benchmark for VTON evaluation.

AI.title_translation: OpenVTON-Bench：用于可控虚拟试穿评估的大规模高分辨率基准测试
AI.tldr: OpenVTON-Bench通过大规模高分辨率数据集和多维度多模态评估协议，解决了虚拟试穿领域评估指标与人类感知不一致的难题。
AI.motivation: 现有虚拟试穿评估方法难以量化纹理细节和语义一致性，且现有数据集在规模和多样性上无法满足商业标准，导致模型评估不可靠。
AI.method: 构建包含10万对高分辨率图像的OpenVTON-Bench数据集；利用DINOv3进行分层聚类采样，并使用Gemini进行稠密标注；提出包含背景、身份、纹理、形状和真实感五个维度的多模态评估协议，结合VLM语义推理与基于SAM3的多尺度表示度量。
AI.result: 该基准测试在评估结果上与人类判断高度一致（Kendall's τ为0.833，远高于SSIM的0.611），成功实现了对虚拟试穿质量的稳健评估。
AI.conclusion: OpenVTON-Bench 通过大规模、高分辨率的数据集及多维度的多模态评估协议，显著提升了虚拟试穿系统评估的客观性和与人类感知的对齐度。
AI.translation: 扩散模型的最新进展显著提升了虚拟试穿（VTON）系统的视觉保真度，但可靠的评估仍然是一个持久的瓶颈。传统指标难以量化细粒度的纹理细节和语义一致性，而现有数据集在规模和多样性上未能达到商业标准。我们提出了OpenVTON-Bench，这是一个包含约10万对高分辨率图像（最高可达1536×1536）的大规模基准测试。该数据集利用基于DINOv3的分层聚类进行语义平衡采样，并结合Gemini驱动的稠密标注，确保了20个细粒度服装类别分布的均匀性。为了支持可靠的评估，我们提出了一种多模态协议，从背景一致性、身份保真度、纹理保真度、形状合理性和整体真实感五个可解释维度衡量VTON质量。该协议将基于VLM的语义推理与基于SAM3分割和形态学腐蚀的新型多尺度表示度量相结合，实现了边界对齐误差与内部纹理伪影的分离。实验结果表明，该评估方法与人类判断高度一致（Kendall's τ为0.833，而SSIM为0.611），为VTON评估建立了一个稳健的基准。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了OpenVTON-Bench，这是一个大规模、高分辨率的虚拟试穿基准测试集。它包含约10万对图像，通过先进的聚类和标注技术保证了数据的多样性。同时，作者提出了一套多维度、多模态的评估协议，能够有效量化试穿过程中的细节和语义一致性，并经实验证明其与人类判断高度一致。
AI.keywords: 虚拟试穿, 基准测试, 扩散模型, 多模态评估, 高分辨率
AI.comments: 该论文针对虚拟试穿（VTON）领域评估指标滞后的问题，提出了一个高质量、大规模的基准测试集。其创新点在于引入了多模态评估协议，通过结合VLM语义推理和SAM3多尺度表示指标，成功解决了传统像素级指标（如SSIM）无法量化纹理和语义一致性的痛点，具有很强的实用价值和学术参考意义。

title: Syntax- and Compilation-Preserving Evasion of LLM Vulnerability Detectors
summary: LLM-based vulnerability detectors are increasingly deployed in CI/CD security gating, yet their resilience to evasion under syntax- and compilation-preserving edits remains poorly understood. We evaluate five attack variants spanning four carrier families of behavior-preserving code transformations on a unified C/C++ benchmark ($N=5000$) and introduce Complete Resistance (CR), measuring the fraction of correctly detected vulnerabilities that withstand all attack variants. Our findings reveal a significant robustness gap: models achieving 70\%+ clean recall exhibit CR as low as 0.12\%, meaning over 87\% of detected vulnerabilities can be evaded by at least one syntax-preserving edit. Universal adversarial strings optimized on a 14B surrogate transfer effectively to black-box APIs including GPT-4o, while on-target optimization further amplifies evasion (up to 92.5\% ASR). These results indicate that clean benchmark accuracy alone is insufficient as a security guarantee for deployed vulnerability detectors.

AI.title_translation: 语法与编译保持的LLM漏洞检测器绕过研究
AI.tldr: LLM漏洞检测器在面对语法保持的对抗性攻击时非常脆弱，即使是表现良好的模型也极易被绕过，仅靠基准测试准确率无法保证安全性。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的漏洞检测器在CI/CD流程中应用广泛，但其在面对语法和编译保持的对抗性攻击时的鲁棒性尚未得到充分验证。
AI.method: 使用四种行为保持的代码转换技术生成五种攻击变体，在C/C++基准测试集上进行评估；引入“完全抵抗力（CR）”指标；利用14B代理模型进行对抗性字符串优化及黑盒API迁移测试。
AI.result: 研究发现模型鲁棒性存在巨大差距：尽管模型在清晰代码上表现出70%+的召回率，但完全抵抗力（CR）最低仅为0.12%；对抗性攻击在GPT-4o等黑盒模型上迁移成功，针对性优化后的攻击成功率高达92.5%。
AI.conclusion: 现有的LLM漏洞检测器在面对语法和编译保持的对抗性攻击时极其脆弱，单一的基准测试准确率不能作为安全保障的充分指标。
AI.translation: 基于LLM的漏洞检测器越来越多地部署在CI/CD安全门控中，但它们在语法和编译保持的编辑下对绕过攻击的抵御能力尚不明确。我们在统一的C/C++基准测试（N=5000）上评估了涵盖四种行为保持代码转换的五种攻击变体，并引入了“完全抵抗力（CR）”指标，用于衡量能够抵御所有攻击变体的正确检测漏洞的比例。研究结果揭示了显著的鲁棒性差距：模型在清晰代码上达到70%+的召回率，但CR最低仅为0.12%，这意味着超过87%的已检测漏洞可以通过至少一种语法保持编辑来绕过。在14B代理模型上优化的通用对抗字符串可有效迁移至包括GPT-4o在内的黑盒API，而针对性优化进一步提升了绕过效果（攻击成功率高达92.5%）。这些结果表明，仅凭清晰的基准测试准确率不足以作为已部署漏洞检测器的安全保证。
AI.summary: 本文评估了LLM漏洞检测器在语法和编译保持的代码转换攻击下的鲁棒性。研究发现，尽管模型在标准测试中表现良好，但极易被多种轻微的语法保持编辑所绕过，证明了现有模型作为安全防御手段存在重大隐患。
AI.keywords: LLM漏洞检测, 对抗性攻击, 鲁棒性评估, 语法保持变换, CI/CD安全
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了现有大模型漏洞检测器在面对语法和编译保持的对抗性攻击时的脆弱性。其创新点在于定义了“完全抵抗力（CR）”指标，并证明了仅靠基准测试集的准确率不足以评估安全工具的鲁棒性，这对自动化安全审计系统的部署具有重要的警示作用。

title: CLAMP: Contrastive Learning for 3D Multi-View Action-Conditioned Robotic Manipulation Pretraining
comments: Accepted to the Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS) 2026
summary: Leveraging pre-trained 2D image representations in behavior cloning policies has achieved great success and has become a standard approach for robotic manipulation. However, such representations fail to capture the 3D spatial information about objects and scenes that is essential for precise manipulation. In this work, we introduce Contrastive Learning for 3D Multi-View Action-Conditioned Robotic Manipulation Pretraining (CLAMP), a novel 3D pre-training framework that utilizes point clouds and robot actions. From the merged point cloud computed from RGB-D images and camera extrinsics, we re-render multi-view four-channel image observations with depth and 3D coordinates, including dynamic wrist views, to provide clearer views of target objects for high-precision manipulation tasks. The pre-trained encoders learn to associate the 3D geometric and positional information of objects with robot action patterns via contrastive learning on large-scale simulated robot trajectories. During encoder pre-training, we pre-train a Diffusion Policy to initialize the policy weights for fine-tuning, which is essential for improving fine-tuning sample efficiency and performance. After pre-training, we fine-tune the policy on a limited amount of task demonstrations using the learned image and action representations. We demonstrate that this pre-training and fine-tuning design substantially improves learning efficiency and policy performance on unseen tasks. Furthermore, we show that CLAMP outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across six simulated tasks and five real-world tasks. The project website and videos can be found at https://clamp3d.github.io/CLAMP/.
