title: Joint Communication and Trajectory Design for Movable Antenna Systems
summary: Movable antennas (MAs) have attracted significant attention in wireless communications due to their ability to reconfigure channel conditions by flexibly adjusting the antenna positions within a confined region. However, MA movement generally incurs a non-negligible delay, which may significantly limit the data transmission time at optimized positions. To tackle this challenge, this paper investigates a new joint communication and trajectory optimization problem, where each MA transmits while moving along an optimized trajectory to prolong the effective data transmission time. Focusing on a single-MA system, our goal is to maximize the average data rate by optimizing the MA's positions over time, subject to its maximum velocity constraints. However, this continuous-time antenna position optimization problem is highly non-convex and challenging to solve. To tackle this challenge, we first consider a special case with two channel paths and derive the optimal MA trajectory in closed form. For other general cases, we ingeniously reformulate the average rate maximization problem into a fixed-hop shortest path problem in graph theory by sampling the antenna movement region into a multitude of discrete points, and solve it optimally. Simulation results demonstrate that our proposed algorithm can significantly improve the data rate compared to other baseline schemes.

AI.title_translation: 移动天线系统的联合通信与轨迹设计
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对移动天线系统的轨迹优化算法，通过将天线位置优化问题转化为图论中的最短路径问题，在克服运动延迟限制的同时显著提升了数据传输速率。
AI.motivation: 现有移动天线系统在调整位置时存在不可忽略的延迟，限制了数据传输时间。需要通过优化天线在运动过程中的轨迹，以延长有效传输时间并提高平均数据速率。
AI.method: 首先针对两径信道推导了闭式解；对于一般情况，通过将天线移动区域离散化，将平均速率最大化问题转化为图论中的固定跳数最短路径问题进行求解。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提出的算法相比于其他基准方案，能够显著提高系统的平均数据速率。
AI.conclusion: 通过将天线移动区域离散化，利用图论方法成功实现了移动天线轨迹的优化，显著提升了系统的平均数据速率。
AI.translation: 由于移动天线（MAs）能够在有限区域内灵活调整位置以重构信道条件，它们在无线通信领域引起了广泛关注。然而，天线移动通常会产生不可忽视的延迟，这可能会严重限制在优化位置上的数据传输时间。为了应对这一挑战，本文研究了一个新的联合通信与轨迹优化问题，即每个移动天线在沿优化轨迹移动的同时进行传输，以延长有效数据传输时间。针对单移动天线系统，我们的目标是在满足最大速度约束的前提下，通过优化天线随时间的位置来最大化平均数据速率。然而，这个连续时间的天线位置优化问题具有高度非凸性，求解难度极大。为了解决这一挑战，我们首先考虑了具有两条信道路径的特殊情况，并推导出了闭式形式的最优移动天线轨迹。对于其他一般情况，我们将天线移动区域采样为多个离散点，巧妙地将平均速率最大化问题转化为图论中的固定跳数最短路径问题，并实现了最优求解。仿真结果表明，与其它基准方案相比，我们提出的算法可以显著提高数据速率。
AI.summary: 本文针对移动天线系统提出了一种联合通信与轨迹优化方案，旨在通过优化天线在移动过程中的轨迹来延长数据传输时间。研究通过将连续位置优化问题转化为离散化的图论最短路径问题，有效解决了非凸优化难题，并验证了该方法在提升数据速率方面的显著优势。
AI.keywords: 移动天线, 轨迹优化, 联合通信设计, 图论, 数据速率最大化
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将移动天线（MA）的物理位置优化问题转化为图论中的最短路径问题，巧妙地解决了连续时间轨迹优化的高非凸性挑战，对于提升移动通信系统的频谱效率具有重要的理论和应用价值。

title: Quantum Meets SAR: A Novel Range-Doppler Algorithm for Next-Gen Earth Observation
summary: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) plays a vital role in remote sensing due to its ability to capture high-resolution images regardless of weather conditions or daylight. However, to transform the raw SAR signals into interpretable imagery, advanced data processing techniques are essential. A widely used technique for this purpose is the Range Doppler Algorithm (RDA), which takes advantage of Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) to convert signals into the frequency domain for further processing. However, the computational cost of this approach becomes significant when dealing with large datasets. This paper presents a Quantum Range Doppler Algorithm (QRDA) that utilizes the Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) to accelerate processing compared to the classical FFT. Furthermore, it introduces a quantum implementation of the Range Cell Migration Correction (RCMC) in the Fourier domain, a critical step in the RDA pipeline that realigns the received echoes so that the energy from a target is concentrated in a single range bin across all azimuth positions. The performance of the quantum RCMC is evaluated and compared against its classical counterpart, demonstrating the potential of quantum computing in advanced SAR imaging.

AI.keywords: SAR, 量子计算, 距离-多普勒算法, 量子傅里叶变换, 范围单元迁移校正
AI.comments: 该研究开创性地将量子计算应用于SAR图像处理，特别是通过QRDA和量子RCMC解决了经典算法的计算效率问题。其潜在的加速能力对于处理日益增长的SAR数据至关重要。未来的工作可以进一步探索不同量子硬件平台上的实现以及更复杂的SAR成像场景。

title: PdNeuRAM: forming-free, multi-bit Pd/HfO2 ReRAM for energy-efficient neuromorphic computing
comments: 32 pages, 6 figures in main text and 7 figures in supporting information
summary: Memristor technology shows great promise for energy-efficient computing, yet it grapples with challenges like resistance drift and inherent variability. For filamentary Resistive RAM (ReRAM), one of the most investigated types of memristive devices, the expensive electroforming step required to create conductive pathways results in increased power and area overheads and reduced endurance. In this study, we present novel HfO2-based forming-free ReRAM devices, PdNeuRAM, that operate at low voltages, support multi-bit functionality, and display reduced variability. Through a deep understanding and comprehensive material characterization, we discover the key process that allows this unique behavior: a Pd-O-Hf configuration that capitalizes on Pd innate affinity for integrating into HfO2. This structure actively facilitates charge redistribution at room temperature, effectively eliminating the need for electroforming. Moreover, the fabricated ReRAM device provides tunable resistance states for dense memory and reduces programming and reading energy by 43% and 73%, respectively, using spiking neural networks (SNN). This study reveals novel mechanistic insights and delineates a strategic roadmap for the realization of power-efficient and cost-effective ReRAM devices.

title: Randompack: Cross-Platform Reproducible Random Number Generation and Distribution Sampling
summary: A C library for random number generation, Randompack, is presented. The library implements several modern random number generators (engines), including xoshiro256, PCG64, Philox, ranlux++, and sfc64; 14 continuous distributions including uniform, normal, exponential, gamma, beta, and multivariate normal; raw bit streams, bounded integers, permutations, and sampling without replacement. The engine and the distribution layers are separated so any engine can be used with any distribution. Benchmarks show that Randompack is faster overall than competing libraries, with speedup factors ranging from about 1 to 15 depending on engine, distribution, interface, and platform. A distinguishing feature is reproducibility: with the same seeds Randompack gives compatible results across programming languages, computers, CPU architectures, and compilers. The library includes comprehensive support for parallel simulation. It is accompanied by a comprehensive test suite, benchmarking programs, and example programs. Interfaces to Fortran, Python, Julia, and R have been implemented; their benchmark results are included, although their design and implementation are otherwise outside the scope of the article. Unlike other available C libraries with comparable scope, Randompack is permissively licensed under the MIT license, and it is open source and publicly available through GitHub and conda-forge.

AI.title_translation: Randompack：跨平台可复现的随机数生成与分布采样库
AI.tldr: Randompack 是一个高性能、可复现的 C 语言随机数库，支持多种语言接口，能在不同平台间产生一致的随机数结果。

AI.conclusion: Randompack 是一个高性能、可复现且易于集成的随机数生成库，能够满足现代并行科学计算的需求。

title: BOIN Designs for Dose Escalation With Selected Dose Combinations in Oncology Phase I Trials
summary: In phase I dose escalation studies for dual-agent combinations, at least one drug often has an established monotherapy dose. Consequently, substantial prior clinical safety data often exist for one or more monotherapies, allowing the study to focus on a subset of selected dose combinations rather than exhaustively evaluating all possible dose combinations for two agents. The Bayesian Optimal Interval (BOIN) design framework is widely recognized for its robust performance and ease of implementation; however, the BOIN for combination design, abbreviated as BOIN-C in this paper, was originally developed to evaluate full combinations and may not be directly applicable for the subset of selected combinations. In this paper, we propose three extensions to the BOIN-C design to address scenarios involving selected dose combinations: (a) BOIN-CS: a generalized BOIN-C design to accommodate any subset of dose combinations. (b) BOIN-CE: Exploration of new off-diagonal dose combinations when de-escalating. This option provides additional opportunities to treat patients with dose combinations that have not been administered. (c) BOIN-CB: Bayesian logistic regression model (BLRM)-guided BOIN design, which uses the BLRM model to break the tie when two dose combinations have an equal posterior probability of being selected. This can be useful when the dose-toxicity relationship is expected to be reasonably aligned with a logistic relationship. These study design options are motivated by practical considerations, and their operating characteristics are evaluated through extensive simulations under various scenarios, demonstrating satisfactory performance.

AI.title_translation: 针对肿瘤I期临床试验中选定剂量组合的BOIN剂量递增设计
AI.tldr: 针对双药组合I期试验，本文提出了三种BOIN-C的扩展方法，以优化对部分选定剂量组合的评估，提升了临床试验设计的灵活性。
AI.motivation: 现有的BOIN-C设计主要针对全组合场景，无法直接高效地应用于临床中常见的仅需评估部分选定剂量组合的场景。
AI.method: 提出了三种BOIN-C设计的扩展方法：(a) BOIN-CS：适用于任何剂量组合子集的广义设计；(b) BOIN-CE：在降阶时探索未使用的离对角线剂量组合；(c) BOIN-CB：利用贝叶斯逻辑回归模型(BLRM)解决剂量选择平局问题。
AI.result: 通过广泛的模拟研究，证明了这三种扩展设计在多种场景下均能保持稳健的性能，且比原始设计更适用于部分组合的临床试验。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，所提出的三种BOIN-C扩展设计（BOIN-CS、BOIN-CE、BOIN-CB）在处理特定的组合剂量试验场景中表现出良好的运行特性，能够有效提升试验设计的灵活性和安全性。
AI.translation: 在双药组合的I期剂量递增研究中，至少有一种药物通常已有确定的单药剂量。因此，针对一种或多种单药通常已有大量的临床安全性数据，使得研究可以专注于选定的剂量组合子集，而不是详尽评估两种药物的所有可能组合。贝叶斯最优区间（BOIN）设计框架因其稳健的性能和易于实施而广受认可；然而，本文中的组合设计（简称BOIN-C）最初是为评估全组合而开发的，可能不直接适用于选定组合的子集。在本文中，我们提出了BOIN-C设计的三种扩展，以应对涉及选定剂量组合的场景：（a）BOIN-CS：一种广义的BOIN-C设计，以适应任何剂量组合的子集。（b）BOIN-CE：在降阶时探索新的离对角线剂量组合。此选项为使用未给药的剂量组合治疗患者提供了更多机会。（c）BOIN-CB：贝叶斯逻辑回归模型（BLRM）引导的BOIN设计，当两个剂量组合被选中的后验概率相等时，使用BLRM模型打破平局。这在剂量-毒性关系预期符合逻辑关系时非常有用。这些研究设计选项是出于实际考虑，并通过在各种场景下的大量模拟评估了其运行特性，表现出令人满意的性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对肿瘤I期双药组合试验，提出了三种对BOIN-C设计的扩展方法（BOIN-CS、BOIN-CE、BOIN-CB），旨在解决仅需评估部分选定剂量组合的实际需求，并通过模拟验证了其优越的性能。
AI.keywords: BOIN设计, 剂量递增, 组合药物试验, 临床试验设计, 贝叶斯统计
AI.comments: 该论文针对现有BOIN-C设计在处理组合药物试验中部分组合选择时的局限性，提出了三种实用的扩展方案。其创新点在于提升了设计在特定临床场景下的灵活性和适用性，通过模拟验证了其稳健性，对药物研发具有重要的实际指导意义。

title: A Zero-Inflated Beta Mixture Model for Marginal Mediation Analysis with Compositional Microbiome Mediators
comments: 19 pages including references; 2 figures; Seungjun Ahn, Quran Wu: These authors contributed equally
summary: The role of the microbiome in disease pathogenesis is an emerging field with strong evidence suggesting that dysbiosis is associated with precancerous and cancerous states. Microbiome data present substantial challenges for causal mediation analysis due to sparsity, compositional constraints, and latent heterogeneity. To address these issues, we propose a zero-inflated beta mixture (ZIBM) method for mediation analysis with compositional microbiome mediators. The proposed method accommodates excess zeros through a zero-inflation component and captures heterogeneity in non-zero relative abundances using a beta mixture distribution. Within the potential-outcomes framework, the ZIBM provides estimates of marginal microbiome-mediated causal effects, and model parameters are estimated using an expectation-maximization algorithm. Simulation studies demonstrate that the ZIBM yields more accurate estimation and reliable inference under conditions commonly observed in microbiome data, compared with existing approaches. An application to a real microbiome study further illustrates its practical utility. These results indicate that the proposed method provides a more flexible and robust statistical framework for mediation analysis involving compositional microbiome data.

AI.keywords: 微生物组, 中介分析, 零膨胀Beta混合模型, 成分数据, 因果推断
AI.comments: 该研究针对微生物组数据特有的稀疏性、成分约束和潜在异质性提出了创新性的统计框架，通过零膨胀Beta混合模型有效解决了传统方法在处理此类复杂数据时的局限性，在因果中介分析领域具有重要的方法学价值。

title: Penalized KLIC Model Selection for the Generalized Method of Moments in Longitudinal Data with Time-Dependent Covariates
summary: Model selection plays an important role in longitudinal data analysis, especially when models are estimated using the generalized method of moments (GMM) in the presence of time-dependent covariates. In this setting, the number of valid moment conditions can grow quickly and may lead to over-parameterized models. The Kullback--Leibler Information Criterion (KLIC) has been proposed as a model-selection tool for this framework; however, the original KLIC criterion may favor overly complex models when the number of parameters or valid moment conditions increases. To address this limitation, this study proposes two penalized versions of KLIC that incorporate penalties based on both the number of model parameters and the number of valid moment conditions. The proposed criteria are referred to as the Moment--Parameter Product Penalty KLIC (MPPP--KLIC) and the Logarithmic Penalty KLIC (LP--KLIC). These criteria provide a theoretically motivated mechanism for balancing model fit and model complexity in GMM-based longitudinal models. Through an extensive simulation study involving both binary and continuous response settings, the proposed criteria are shown to improve the ability of KLIC to distinguish among competing models and to reduce the selection of over-parameterized models. The performance of the proposed methods is further illustrated using the Filipino Child Morbidity dataset, a longitudinal study of child health in the Philippines. The results show that the proposed penalized criteria provide stable and interpretable model rankings and consistently identify age as the most important predictor of child morbidity. Overall, the proposed penalized KLIC criteria offer practical and theoretically grounded tools for model selection in GMM-based longitudinal data analysis with time-dependent covariates.

AI.title_translation: 针对含时协变量纵向数据中广义矩估计的惩罚KLIC模型选择研究
AI.tldr: 本文提出了两种改进的惩罚KLIC准则，用于解决广义矩估计（GMM）在纵向数据分析中因矩条件过多导致的模型过拟合问题。
AI.motivation: 在纵向数据分析中，当使用GMM估计且存在含时协变量时，有效的矩条件数量增长过快，导致原有的KLIC准则倾向于选择过于复杂的模型，产生过拟合现象。
AI.method: 提出了两种惩罚KLIC模型选择方法：MPPP-KLIC（矩-参数乘积惩罚）和LP-KLIC（对数惩罚），分别通过在原KLIC准则中增加针对模型参数数量和有效矩条件数量的惩罚项来实现。
AI.result: 模拟研究表明，新方法能更准确地辨别竞争模型并显著降低过拟合风险；在菲律宾儿童发病率数据集的应用中，该方法提供了稳健且可解释的模型排序，成功识别出年龄作为主要预测因子。
AI.conclusion: 提出的MPPP-KLIC和LP-KLIC准则能有效平衡模型拟合度与复杂度，在处理含时协变量的纵向数据分析中，优于传统的KLIC准则，是更优的模型选择工具。
AI.translation: 模型选择在纵向数据分析中发挥着重要作用，特别是在存在含时协变量且使用广义矩估计（GMM）进行模型估计时。在这种背景下，有效矩条件的数量会迅速增加，可能导致模型参数过多。Kullback--Leibler信息准则（KLIC）已被提议作为该框架下的模型选择工具；然而，当参数或有效矩条件的数量增加时，原始的KLIC准则可能会偏向于过于复杂的模型。为了解决这一局限性，本研究提出了两个KLIC的惩罚版本，它们结合了基于模型参数数量和有效矩条件数量的惩罚项。所提出的准则被称为矩-参数乘积惩罚KLIC（MPPP-KLIC）和对数惩罚KLIC（LP-KLIC）。这些准则为平衡GMM纵向模型中的模型拟合和模型复杂度提供了一种具有理论依据的机制。通过涉及二元和连续响应设置的大量模拟研究，所提出的准则被证明提高了KLIC区分竞争模型的能力，并减少了过度参数化模型的选择。通过菲律宾儿童发病率数据集（一项关于菲律宾儿童健康的纵向研究）进一步说明了所提出方法的性能。结果表明，所提出的惩罚准则提供了稳定且可解释的模型排序，并始终将年龄识别为儿童发病率最重要的预测因子。总体而言，所提出的惩罚KLIC准则为具有含时协变量的GMM纵向数据分析中的模型选择提供了实用且具有理论基础的工具。
AI.summary: 本文针对GMM估计下的纵向数据分析，提出了两种改进的惩罚KLIC模型选择准则（MPPP-KLIC与LP-KLIC）。通过对模型参数和有效矩条件施加双重惩罚，该方法有效解决了传统KLIC在处理含时协变量时易导致模型过拟合的问题，并在模拟实验和实际数据应用中证明了其有效性和稳健性。
AI.keywords: 广义矩估计, 纵向数据, 模型选择, KLIC, 含时协变量
AI.comments: 该论文针对广义矩估计（GMM）在处理纵向数据时存在的过拟合问题，通过引入惩罚项优化了KLIC准则。其创新点在于将参数数量与矩条件数量同时纳入惩罚机制，有效提升了模型选择的稳健性，具有较强的理论支撑和实际应用价值。

title: Confirmation of Binary Clustering in Gamma-Ray Bursts through an Integrated $p$-value from Multiple Nonparametric Tests of Hypotheses
summary: The paper applies a new, nonparametric, interpoint distance-based measure to confirm the inherent groups prevailing in the brightest source of light in the universe: gamma-ray bursts. Our effective metric, in association with clustering methods like Gaussian-mixture model-based and $K$-means algorithms, resolves the conflict regarding the possibility about existence of more than binary clusters in the gamma-ray burst population. Here we carry out multiple nonparametric statistical tests of hypotheses, as many as the number of bursts available from the `BATSE' catalog. An integrated $p$-value achieved from the aforesaid dependent tests solves our concern confirming two groups of short and long bursts.

AI.title_translation: 通过多重非参数假设检验的集成p值确认伽马射线暴的二元聚类特征
AI.tldr: 通过新的非参数统计方法，确认了伽马射线暴仅存在长、短两类，解决了学术界关于其分类数量的争议。
AI.motivation: 伽马射线暴群体中是否存在超过两个（二元）聚类一直存在争议，作者旨在通过更严谨的统计方法解决这一冲突。
AI.method: 应用基于点间距离的非参数度量方法，结合高斯混合模型和K-means聚类算法，并利用来自BATSE目录的所有爆发数据进行多重非参数假设检验，最终通过集成p值来验证结果。
AI.result: 通过集成p值分析，确认了伽马射线暴群体中仅存在短暴和长暴这两个明确的群体。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论明确支持伽马射线暴存在两个固有群体，即短暴和长暴，排除了存在更多聚类的可能性。
AI.translation: 本文应用了一种新的、基于点间距离的非参数度量方法，以确认宇宙中最亮光源——伽马射线暴中存在的固有群体。我们有效的度量方法，结合诸如基于高斯混合模型和K-means算法等聚类方法，解决了关于伽马射线暴群体中是否存在超过二元聚类的冲突。在此，我们执行了多重非参数统计假设检验，数量与BATSE目录中可用的爆发次数相同。从上述相关检验中获得的集成p值解决了我们的担忧，确认了短暴和长暴这两个群体。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于非参数点间距离度量的新方法，通过结合高斯混合模型和K-means聚类，并利用BATSE目录数据进行多重假设检验，通过集成p值证实了伽马射线暴仅分为短暴和长暴两个群体。
AI.keywords: 伽马射线暴, 非参数统计, 聚类分析, 统计假设检验, BATSE目录
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入一种创新的非参数统计方法，有效解决了伽马射线暴分类中关于聚类数量的争议。其核心价值在于利用集成p值方法增强了统计结论的鲁棒性，为天体物理学分类问题提供了严谨的统计学支持。

title: A Convolution Process for Sea Surface Temperature Hot-Spot Identification in the Mediterranean Sea
summary: Sea surface temperature (SST) is a fundamental determinant of global climate dynamics and economic activity. Reliable projections of future SST patterns depend critically on a rigorous characterization of the underlying spatial random field. In this study, we introduce a novel convolution-based covariance framework tailored to geostatistical domains constrained by physical barriers and influenced by vector-driven flows. By discretizing the continuous marine domain into a directed linear network that preserves the orientation of ocean currents, we construct a moving-average stochastic process whose dynamic is encoded via a Markovian transition-probability matrix on the network's vertices. The induced covariance structure emerges as a weighted combination of a spatial kernel and flow-dependent weights, giving rise to a complex estimation problem. To stabilize inference, we propose a penalized estimator that regularizes covariance parameters while enforcing consistency with known hydrodynamic properties. We then embed this covariance model into a Monte Carlo simulation framework to refine RCP-based SST projections and to identify thermal 'hot spots' of heightened ecological risk. Our approach delivers a statistically principled framework that prevents physical inconsistencies -- such as correlations across land barriers -- providing a robust basis for quantifying uncertainty in future SST forecasts and for guiding targeted environmental assessments.

title: A Bayesian Age-Period-Cohort approach for modeling fertility in Puerto Rico
summary: Puerto Rico has one of the lowest total fertility rates (TFR) in the world. Combined with a negative net migration and a high proportion of older adults, its unique situation motivates the need for further demographic analysis. Determining whether low fertility rates are mostly due to period or cohort effects is crucial for developing effective public policies that adapt to changes in fertility and population structures. The main objective of this work is to develop an Age-Period-Cohort model, in order to describe fertility data in Puerto Rico, from 1948-2022 and determine the contribution of period and cohort effects to fertility decline. The APC model was developed following a Bayesian framework, with a Poisson likelihood, RW(2) autorregressive priors for the APC parameters, and Scaled Beta2 priors for the precision parameters. Both frequentist and Bayesian methodologies attribute more importance to cohort effects when explaining fertility changes in Puerto Rico. Birth cohorts born in 1963-1967 onward have notably low fertility rates. There is no evidence of postponement of births in Puerto Rico, contrary to other countries with lowest-low fertility. Birth cohorts born in 1963-1967 onward have notably low fertility rates. This is the first application of APC analysis to fertility data in Puerto Rico, which describes fertility changes in a unique scenario in terms of demographic indicators, and the first APC analysis that shows the predominance of cohort effects when explaining fertility.

title: Incorporating estimands into meta-analyses of clinical trials
comments: 28 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Version accepted for publication by Research Synthesis Methods following minor revisions
summary: The estimand framework is increasingly established to pose research questions in confirmatory clinical trials. In evidence synthesis, the uptake of estimands has been modest, and the PICO (Population, Intervention, Comparator, Outcome) framework is more often applied. While PICOs and estimands have overlapping elements, the estimand framework explicitly considers different strategies for intercurrent events. We propose a pragmatic framework for the use of estimands in meta-analyses of clinical trials, highlighting the value of estimands to systematically identify and mitigate key sources of quantitative heterogeneity, and to enhance the applicability or external validity of pooled estimates. Focus is placed on the role of strategies for intercurrent events, within the specific context of meta-analyses for health technology assessment. We apply the estimand framework to a network meta-analysis of clinical trials, comparing the efficacy of semaglutide versus dulaglutide in type 2 diabetes. We explore the impact of a treatment policy strategy for treatment discontinuation or initiation of rescue medication versus a hypothetical strategy for the corresponding intercurrent events. The specification of different target estimands at the meta-analytical level allows us to be explicit about the source of heterogeneity, the intercurrent event strategy, driving any potential differences in results. We advocate for the integration of estimands into the planning of meta-analyses, while acknowledging that potential challenges exist in the absence of subject-level data. Estimands can complement PICOs to strengthen communication between stakeholders about what evidence syntheses seek to demonstrate, and to ensure that the generated evidence is maximally relevant to healthcare decision-makers.

AI.title_translation: 将估计目标（Estimands）纳入临床试验荟萃分析
AI.tldr: 本文提出在荟萃分析中引入 estimand 框架，通过明确处理期间事件的策略，系统化解决异质性问题，从而提升临床证据合成的决策参考价值。
AI.motivation: 现有的荟萃分析多依赖 PICO 框架，但该框架在处理临床试验中的“期间事件”时缺乏明确性，导致证据合成的异质性难以精准识别与控制。
AI.method: 提出了一种用于临床试验荟萃分析的实用估计目标（estimand）框架，侧重于系统识别和减轻定量异质性，并通过对司美格鲁肽与度拉糖肽的网状荟萃分析进行实证，对比了“治疗策略”与“假设策略”在处理期间事件时的差异。
AI.result: 研究表明，在荟萃分析层面上明确估计目标，能有效揭示由期间事件策略导致的异质性来源，使证据合成结果更具解释力，并能更好地支持医疗决策。
AI.conclusion: 将 estimand 框架整合进荟萃分析，能够显著提升证据合成的透明度与决策相关性，是解决临床试验异质性及提升外部有效性的有效工具。
AI.translation: 估计目标（estimand）框架已在确证性临床试验中确立了研究问题的提出方式。在证据合成中，对 estimand 的采纳尚显缓慢，PICO（人群、干预、对照、结局）框架应用更为广泛。尽管 PICO 和 estimand 有重叠部分，但 estimand 框架明确考虑了处理期间事件的不同策略。我们提出了一种在临床试验荟萃分析中使用 estimand 的实用框架，强调了 estimand 在系统识别和减轻定量异质性关键来源以及增强汇总估计的适用性或外部有效性方面的价值。重点关注了在卫生技术评估的荟萃分析特定背景下，处理期间事件策略的作用。我们将 estimand 框架应用于比较司美格鲁肽与度拉糖肽治疗 2 型糖尿病的临床试验网状荟萃分析中。我们探讨了针对治疗中断或启动补救药物的“治疗政策策略”与针对相应期间事件的“假设策略”的影响。在荟萃分析层面明确不同的目标 estimand，使我们能够明确异质性的来源及驱动任何潜在结果差异的期间事件策略。我们提倡在荟萃分析规划中整合 estimand，同时也承认在缺乏个体受试者数据时存在潜在挑战。Estimand 可以补充 PICO，加强利益相关者之间关于证据合成旨在证明什么的沟通，并确保所生成的证据与医疗决策者高度相关。
AI.summary: 本文提出在临床试验荟萃分析中引入 estimand 框架，旨在解决传统 PICO 框架在处理期间事件方面的不足。通过系统化处理估计目标，该方法能够降低异质性，增强证据的外部有效性，并以糖尿病药物的网状荟萃分析为例，展示了如何通过明确期间事件策略来提升证据分析的科学性与决策相关性。
AI.keywords: 临床试验, 荟萃分析, 估计目标(Estimands), 期间事件, 异质性
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将 estimand 框架引入荟萃分析，解决了传统 PICO 框架在处理临床试验中“期间事件”（intercurrent events）时的局限性。其重要性在于通过系统化处理异质性，提高了证据合成在医疗决策中的适用性和外部有效性。局限性在于缺乏个体患者数据（IPD）时应用该框架存在一定挑战。

title: Dynamic SIR/SEIR-like models comprising a time-dependent transmission rate: Hamiltonian Monte Carlo approach with applications to COVID-19
summary: A study of changes in the transmission of a disease, in particular, a new disease like COVID-19, requires very flexible models which can capture, among others, the effects of non-pharmacological and pharmacological measures, changes in population behaviour and random events. We favour data-driven approaches over a priori and ad-hoc methods and introduce a generalised family of epidemiologically informed mechanistic models, guided by Ordinary Differential Equations and embedded in a probabilistic model. The mechanistic models SIKR and SEMIKR which divide the population into disjoint compartments for individuals Susceptible to infection, Infectious (K sub-compartments), Exposed (M sub-compartments), and Removed from the pool of susceptible are enriched with a time-dependent transmission rate, parameterised using Bayesian P-splines. Such a parameterisation enables an extensive flexibility in the transmission dynamics, without resorting to ad-hoc specifications. Our probabilistic model relies on the solutions of a mechanistic model and benefits from access to the information about under-reporting of new infected cases, a crucial property when studying diseases with a large fraction of asymptomatic infections. Such a model can be differentiated efficiently, which makes Hamiltonian-based Monte Carlo sampling feasible after a careful initialisation and tuning strategy. This is particularly important in the present setting with weakly identified directions and challenging posterior geometries. Furthermore, we apply our methodology to study the transmission dynamics of COVID-19 in the Basque Country (Spain) from mid February 2020 to the end of January 2021, showing how the framework can recover plausible temporal patterns in transmission while making explicit the dependence of the results on modelling choices and convergence diagnostics.

title: ESG as Priced Crash Insurance: State-Dependent Tail Risk and Deconfounding Evidence
summary: This research establishes ESG as a state dependent insurance mechanism against equity crashes by addressing the decoupling of unconditional alpha from tail risk resilience. By validating market stress regimes as distinct economic states through a drawdown-based truncation rule, the study demonstrates that high ESG ratings materially reduce the incidence of discrete crash events during systemic drawdowns. To address the selection bias and high-dimensional confounding inherent in traditional linear frameworks, we implement Double Machine Learning as a structural deconfounding layer. Unlike simple predictive modeling, the Double Machine Learning framework utilizes machine learning to handle complex nuisance parameters, allowing us to isolate the asymmetric treatment effects of ESG across different market states. Distributional analysis reveals the underlying mechanism as ESG specifically attenuates the severity of realized tail losses at the most adverse quantiles instead of shifting the entire return distribution. Confirmed by structural estimates, this protection functions as priced insurance that incurs performance drags during stable periods while providing critical resilience when tail risks are most acute.

AI.title_translation: 作为定价崩盘保险的ESG：状态依赖的尾部风险与去混淆证据
AI.tldr: ESG并非提升整体收益，而是在市场崩盘期间发挥“保险”作用，通过降低极端尾部风险提供保护，但需以平稳期的业绩拖累为代价。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决ESG在无条件阿尔法（unconditional alpha）与尾部风险韧性之间脱节的问题，并克服传统线性框架在处理选择偏差和高维混淆方面的局限性。
AI.method: 利用基于回撤的截断规则定义不同的市场压力状态，并采用双重机器学习（Double Machine Learning）来处理高维混淆参数，从而隔离ESG在不同市场状态下的不对称处理效应。
AI.result: 实证结果表明，高ESG评级能显著降低系统性回撤期间发生崩盘事件的概率；ESG的作用机制是特异性地减轻最不利分位数下的尾部损失，而非改变整体收益分布。
AI.conclusion: ESG在市场压力期间表现为一种有价值的“保险”机制，它通过降低极端损失来实现风险对冲，但在市场平稳期会产生一定的业绩拖累。
AI.translation: 本研究通过解决无条件阿尔法与尾部风险韧性之间的脱节问题，确立了ESG作为一种针对股市崩盘的状态依赖型保险机制。通过利用基于回撤的截断规则将市场压力制度验证为不同的经济状态，本研究证明了高ESG评级能显著降低系统性回撤期间离散崩盘事件的发生率。为了解决传统线性框架中固有的选择偏差和高维混淆，我们实施了双重机器学习作为结构性去混淆层。与简单的预测建模不同，双重机器学习框架利用机器学习处理复杂的干扰参数，使我们能够隔离ESG在不同市场状态下的不对称处理效应。分布分析揭示了其潜在机制：ESG并非移动整个收益分布，而是专门减轻了最不利分位数下的已实现尾部损失。结构性估计证实，这种保护作为一种定价保险，在稳定时期会产生业绩拖累，同时在尾部风险最严重时提供关键的韧性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了ESG作为一种状态依赖的股市崩盘保险机制。通过双重机器学习框架处理高维混淆，研究发现高ESG评级在市场压力期间能有效缓解极端尾部损失。这种保护机制在市场稳定期表现为成本（业绩拖累），但在极端风险时期提供了关键的韧性。
AI.keywords: ESG, 尾部风险, 双重机器学习, 状态依赖性, 资产定价
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入双重机器学习（DML）方法，成功解决了ESG研究中常见的混淆偏差问题，为理解ESG的“保险”属性提供了严谨的因果推断框架。其核心贡献在于揭示了ESG并非无条件提升收益，而是作为一种具有状态依赖性的尾部风险对冲工具。

title: Do News and Social Media Tell the Same Story? Constructing and Comparing Sentiment Spillover Networks
summary: Investor sentiment reflects the collective attitude of investors towards the asset, whether positive, negative or neutral. Market information, such as news and relevant social media posts, plays a significant role in shaping investor sentiment, which influences investment decisions accordingly. The sentiment for one single company may spill over to other relevant companies which are in the same industry. The information spillover network pattern between news and social media may also differ, as they are two different media sources. In this study, we introduce a network-based transfer entropy method to measure and compare the information transmission of news and social media sentiment across the technology companies. We examine whether and to what extent sentiment information from one company can transfer to other companies, and how different the spillover effect is for news and social media. The result signifies a stronger intensity of news information flow among the tech companies after COVID-19. We also highlight the companies which act as information hubs in the sentiment network. Furthermore, we identify the companies which lead the strongest information flow chain. Overall, this study provides a novel perspective in modelling sentiment spillover under two different media sources, and we find that news and social media show a different information transmission pattern during the studied period.

AI.title_translation: 新闻与社交媒体讲述的是同一个故事吗？构建并比较情绪溢出网络
AI.tldr: 该研究通过传递熵分析发现，新闻与社交媒体在影响科技公司投资者情绪时表现出不同的溢出模式，且新闻的影响力在疫情后显著增强。
AI.motivation: 探讨新闻与社交媒体作为两种不同的信息源，在塑造投资者情绪及在科技公司间产生溢出效应方面是否存在差异。
AI.method: 采用基于网络的传递熵（network-based transfer entropy）方法，构建并对比新闻与社交媒体的情绪溢出网络，识别信息枢纽企业及信息流动链条。
AI.result: 研究发现新闻与社交媒体存在不同的信息传输模式；COVID-19疫情后，科技公司间的新闻信息流强度显著增加；识别出了情绪网络中的关键信息枢纽及领头企业。
AI.conclusion: 新闻和社交媒体在科技行业表现出不同的情绪溢出模式，且在COVID-19疫情后，新闻的信息流动强度显著增强。
AI.translation: 投资者情绪反映了投资者对资产的集体态度，无论是积极的、消极的还是中性的。新闻和相关社交媒体帖子等市场信息在塑造投资者情绪方面发挥着重要作用，进而影响投资决策。单家公司的情绪可能会溢出到同一行业的其他相关公司。新闻和社交媒体之间的信息溢出网络模式可能也不同，因为它们是两种不同的媒体来源。在本研究中，我们引入了一种基于网络的传递熵方法来测量和比较科技公司中新闻和社交媒体情绪的信息传输。我们检验了公司间情绪信息传递的程度，以及新闻和社交媒体溢出效应的差异。结果表明，COVID-19之后，科技公司间的新闻信息流强度更强。我们还强调了在情绪网络中充当信息枢纽的公司，并确定了引领最强信息流动链的公司。总的来说，本研究为模拟两种不同媒体源下的情绪溢出提供了一个新的视角，我们发现新闻和社交媒体在研究期间表现出不同的信息传输模式。
AI.summary: 本文研究了新闻与社交媒体对科技公司投资者情绪的溢出效应，利用传递熵方法构建并比较了两种媒体源的信息传输网络，发现它们表现出不同的传播模式，且新闻在疫情后表现出更强的信息流动性。
AI.keywords: 投资者情绪, 情绪溢出, 传递熵, 新闻与社交媒体, 科技公司
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入基于网络的传递熵方法，创新性地对比了新闻与社交媒体在金融市场中的信息溢出机制，揭示了不同媒体源在投资者情绪传播上的差异。研究结论对于理解市场联动效应及制定投资策略具有重要参考价值，但局限于科技行业。

title: Fast and General Simulation of Lévy-driven Ornstein Uhlenbeck processes for Energy Derivatives
summary: Lévy-driven Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) processes represent an intriguing class of stochastic processes that have garnered interest in the energy sector for their ability to capture typical features of market dynamics. However, in the current state of play, Monte Carlo simulations of these processes are not straightforward for two main reasons: i) algorithms are available only for some specific processes within this class; ii) they are often computationally expensive. In this paper, we introduce a new simulation technique designed to address both challenges. It relies on the numerical inversion of the characteristic function, offering a general methodology applicable to all Lévy-driven OU processes. Moreover, leveraging FFT, the proposed methodology ensures fast and accurate simulations, providing a solid basis for the widespread adoption of these processes in the energy sector. Lastly, the algorithm allows explicit control of the numerical error. We apply the technique to the pricing of energy derivatives, comparing the results with the existing benchmarks. Our findings indicate that the proposed methodology is at least one order of magnitude faster than the existing algorithms, while maintaining an equivalent level of accuracy.

AI.title_translation: 能源衍生品中Lévy驱动Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程的快速通用模拟方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用特征函数数值反演和FFT模拟Lévy驱动OU过程的新方法，显著提高了计算速度，适用于能源衍生品定价。
AI.motivation: 现有的Lévy驱动OU过程模拟方法仅适用于特定类型，且计算成本高昂，难以满足能源市场中广泛应用的需求。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于特征函数数值反演的通用模拟技术，并结合快速傅里叶变换(FFT)来提升计算效率，同时实现对数值误差的显式控制。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在保持与现有基准算法同等准确度的前提下，计算速度至少提升了一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种基于特征函数数值反演和FFT的通用模拟算法，能够高效、准确地模拟各类Lévy驱动的OU过程，并在能源衍生品定价任务中表现出显著的性能优势。
AI.translation: Lévy驱动的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) 过程是一类引人注目的随机过程，因其能够捕捉市场动态的典型特征而在能源领域引起了关注。然而，在当前的研究现状下，这些过程的蒙特卡洛模拟并不简单，主要原因有二：i) 现有的算法仅适用于该类过程中的某些特定类型；ii) 这些算法通常计算成本高昂。在本文中，我们引入了一种旨在解决上述两个挑战的新型模拟技术。它依赖于特征函数的数值反演，提供了一种适用于所有Lévy驱动OU过程的通用方法。此外，通过利用FFT，所提出的方法确保了模拟的快速性和准确性，为这些过程在能源领域的广泛采用奠定了坚实的基础。最后，该算法允许对数值误差进行显式控制。我们将该技术应用于能源衍生品定价，并将结果与现有基准进行了比较。研究结果表明，所提出的方法比现有算法至少快一个数量级，同时保持了同等水平的准确性。
AI.summary: 本文针对Lévy驱动的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程，提出了一种通用的高效模拟方法。该方法利用特征函数数值反演和FFT技术，克服了现有模拟算法适用范围窄和计算耗时的问题，实现了快速、准确且误差可控的模拟，并通过能源衍生品定价案例验证了其卓越性能。
AI.keywords: Lévy驱动的OU过程, 蒙特卡洛模拟, 特征函数数值反演, 快速傅里叶变换(FFT), 能源衍生品定价
AI.comments: 该论文解决了一个实际的金融计算痛点，即复杂随机过程模拟的效率问题。通过引入基于特征函数数值反演和FFT的通用算法，该方法显著提升了计算速度，且具备误差可控性，对于能源衍生品定价等计算密集型应用具有重要的工程价值和推广意义。

title: Scaling Limits of Bivariate Nearly-Unstable Hawkes Processes and Applications to Rough Volatility
summary:
We prove a functional limit theorem for a pair of nearly unstable Hawkes processes coupled through a triangular cross-excitation mechanism, when the two kernels have distinct heavy-tail exponents. This heterogeneous regime produces two different degrees of roughness and, to the best of our knowledge, had not previously been treated in the multivariate nearly unstable setting.
  As the system approaches criticality, the renormalized intensity processes converge weakly to the unique solution of a coupled stochastic Volterra system driven by two independent Brownian motions. The first component evolves autonomously as a rough fractional diffusion, while the second is driven both by its own noise and by the first component through a convolution cross-kernel. This kernel, expressed as the convolution of the two associated Mittag-Leffler kernels, encodes both roughness exponents and distinguishes the limit from independent univariate limits or classical bivariate Brownian models.
  We also derive a short-time decorrelation result showing that the functional correlation between the two limiting components vanishes at an explicit polynomial rate governed by the rougher component. Finally, we show that the scale-matching assumption is not structural: without it, the limiting cross-kernel is replaced by an explicitly time-rescaled convolution kernel. The proof combines kernel convergence, tightness, martingale identification via Rebolledo's theorem, and uniqueness for affine stochastic Volterra equations.

AI.title_translation: 二元近临界Hawkes过程的缩放极限及其在粗糙波动率中的应用
AI.tldr: 本文推导了具有不同粗糙度指数的二元近临界Hawkes过程的极限，证明其收敛于耦合的随机Volterra系统，并揭示了独特的耦合核结构。
AI.motivation: 在多变量近临界Hawkes过程的设置下，现有理论尚未充分处理两个内核具有不同重尾指数（即异构粗糙度）的情况，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 利用核收敛、紧致性分析、基于Rebolledo定理的鞅识别方法，以及仿射随机Volterra方程的唯一性证明。
AI.result: 证明了重归一化的强度过程收敛于耦合的随机Volterra系统；导出了短时去相关结果；明确了比例匹配假设非结构化，并给出了非匹配情况下的极限核形式。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了异构近临界Hawkes过程在缩放极限下收敛于耦合的随机Volterra系统，并揭示了由不同粗糙度指数决定的非平凡耦合结构。
AI.translation: 我们证明了一个通过三角形交叉激励机制耦合的二元近临界Hawkes过程的函数极限定理，其中两个核具有不同的重尾指数。这种异构机制产生了两种不同程度的粗糙度，据我们所知，这在多变量近临界设置中此前尚未被处理。随着系统接近临界状态，重归一化的强度过程弱收敛于由两个独立布朗运动驱动的耦合随机Volterra系统的唯一解。第一个分量作为粗糙分数扩散自主演化，而第二个分量既受其自身噪声驱动，也通过卷积交叉核受第一个分量驱动。该核表示为两个相关的Mittag-Leffler核的卷积，它编码了两个粗糙度指数，并将该极限与独立的单变量极限或经典的二元布朗模型区分开来。我们还导出了一个短时去相关结果，表明两个极限分量之间的函数相关性以由较粗糙分量支配的显式多项式速率消失。最后，我们证明了比例匹配假设并非结构性的：如果去掉该假设，极限交叉核将被显式时间重缩放的卷积核所取代。证明结合了核收敛、紧致性、通过Rebolledo定理进行的鞅识别以及仿射随机Volterra方程的唯一性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了具有不同重尾指数的二元近临界Hawkes过程的缩放极限。研究发现，系统收敛于一个耦合的随机Volterra系统，该系统表现出由两个Mittag-Leffler核卷积定义的独特耦合结构，反映了双重粗糙度特性，并揭示了其在金融粗糙波动率建模中的应用潜力。
AI.keywords: Hawkes过程, 粗糙波动率, 随机Volterra方程, 缩放极限, Mittag-Leffler核
AI.comments: 本文填补了多变量近临界Hawkes过程在异构重尾指数情况下的理论空白。其创新之处在于通过卷积Mittag-Leffler核描述了两个具有不同粗糙度过程之间的耦合关系，为理解金融市场中的粗糙波动率提供了新的数学框架。局限性在于其推导过程极其复杂，且对特定数学假设（如近临界状态）有较高依赖。
